alex depaul.name: Alex DePaul
alex depaul.origin: Alex DePaul was an S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who had been alerted when Majowski of Code: Blue hacked into information from the National Crime Syndicate on Tantalus to assist in their search for the killer Pandara. Immediately, Agent DePaul brought a team of agents to Code: Blue's precinct to arrest all of them and their witness, Mary Jane Watson, and had them confined aboard a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier. When the Helicarrier was boarded by Spider-Man, Thunderstrike, and "Jock" Jackson, DePaul donned his Mandroid armor to confront them. Alongside agents Palamas and Farret, he recruited Hercules to S.H.I.E.L.D. to combat the growing threat of the Warhawks. Unbeknownst to the others, DePaul was in league with the Warhawk's leader Ares and supplying the warlord with information. Palamas and Farret discovered his treachery, but he managed to subdue them with darts before his secret could be revealed. When the Warhawks took over the Helicarrier and Hercules was captured, DePaul revealed his true allegiance. Enraged, Hercules broke free of his chains and chased after Ares, but was nearly stopped by DePaul before Agent Palamas returned to the battle and fought against the turned agent. Hercules knocked the sword from Ares' hand in battle, and it fell to DePaul who used it to gain the upper hand on Palamas. The concussive blast of Ares' destroyed doomsday machine destabilized his footing, and the traitor fell on his own blade.
abilities: Alex DePaul was known to be a master of and duplicity. He possessed his own suit of Mandroid armor which gave him physical protection.

alex flores.name: Alex Flores
alex flores.species: Human mutated by ionic energy, now depowered
alex flores.origin: ===Early Life=== Alex Flores was a talented and driven screenwriter living in Los Angeles with her young daughter, Jamie. She became acquainted with actor-turned-hero Wonder Man through mutual friends and neighbours in the apartment complex managed by Gloria Angel. Unlike many in her creative circle, Alex initially showed little interest in Simon's superhero exploits. However, after he bonded with her daughter and became a fixture in their lives, Alex warmed to him. Her practical nature and storytelling instincts often made her the voice of reason among the group. ===Ionic Transformation=== Alex was one of eight individuals present when Wonder Man was attacked by Angkor and subsequently suffered a violent burst of ionic energy. The exposure subtly altered each of them. Alex eventually discovered she could generate tangible illusions, effectively creating solid objects or personas from her imagination. These illusions were not only visible but could interact physically with the environment an ideal power for someone trained in crafting fictional realities. ===Founding the Crazy Eight=== Although initially reluctant to participate in any superhero activity, Alex was persuaded by Esteban Beach (Stat) to lead the group of newly empowered allies. She adopted the codename Auteur, embracing both her Hollywood background and her power to construct narrative-based illusions. As the leader of the Crazy Eight, Alex coordinated the group during their first mission against the corrupt private security firm Armed Response, which was secretly controlled by Lotus Newmark. Under her guidance, the Eight successfully exposed the criminal operation. However, the team soon came under attack by assassins Splice and Rampage in retaliation. During this ambush, Alex was critically injured, taking a near-fatal blow while protecting her daughter and teammates. ===Retirement=== Following her injury, Alex's soul was drawn into a metaphysical conflict involving Mephisto, Blackheart, and the Grim Reaper. Wonder Man was eventually able to defeat these forces and, in doing so, reabsorbed the ionic energy he had inadvertently shared with his allies. Alex's powers were fully removed in the process. She chose to return to a normal life, focusing on her daughter and screenwriting career. After Wonder Man's apparent death in the battle with the alien Scatter ===Re-Married=== Alex moved on in his absence and eventually married Felix Simon. Alex and Wonder Man reconnected when he was resurrected and parted as friends.

alex grimond.name: Alex Grimond
alex grimond.origin: Alex Grimond was an assassin who wanted to become the world's greatest assassin by killing Foreigner, the leader of the assassin club called the "1400 Club." Grimond learned every security detail and defensive measure that the club's mansion possessed and used this knowledge to break into the house. He encountered the Foreinger in the pool room and the pair fought until Alex was able to kill him. The real Foreigner then arrived and revealed that the slain doppleganger was the last person who had successfully killed his previous double and that if Alex wanted to join the 1400 Club, he would have to become the new doppleganger of the Foreigner and defeat the next person who tried to kill him.

alexander aaron.origin: thumb|left|With Amatsu-Mikaboshi ===Amatsu-Mikaboshi=== Alexander Aaron was the son of Ares, the Olympian god of war, and a mortal woman. Ares had left Olympus because the other Olympians, including Ares' own mother Hera, saw him as a savage instrument of war. Renouncing his role, Ares attempted to raise Alex in a mortal life in a mortal world, though he refused to let Alex see his mother. Despite Ares' efforts to conceal his nature, Alex's tendencies for fighting, or more accurately defending, were displayed as early as third grade. thumb|right|300px|Alex being freed from Amatsu-Mikaboshi's control, after stabbing his father with Grasscutter When Amatsu-Mikaboshi, an evil Japanese entity, assaulted Olympus, Zeus attempted to force his son Ares back into action by kidnapping Alex, but Mikaboshi stole Alex from Zeus' custody. Mikaboshi revealed to Alex his father's true identity and the Greek pantheon's long history of patricide, intending to use Alex to take on Ares' role. Mikaboshi gave Alex cups of his own blood, which awakened Alex's inner divinity and allowed Mikaboshi to control Alex. Mikaboshi then trained the boy in swordsmanship and gave Alex his prized sword called Grasscutter. Sent into battle, Alex under Mikaboshi's control critically wounded Zeus, and he personally stabbed Ares with Grasscutter, staining the blade red. In Zeus' final moments, he released Alex, who then cried at what he had done. Alex seemingly slayed Mikaboshi, ending the battle, and Alex and Ares reunited as gods. Months later, they returned to the human world once more. ===Secret Warriors=== thumb|left|With the Secret Warriors As a member of Nick Fury's Secret Warriors, Alex was given the code name Phobos and was trained alongside Jerry Sledge (Stonewall), J.T. James (Hellfire), Yo-Yo Rodriguez (Slingshot), and Sebastian Druid (The Druid). One of their first missions was to take out the Dard'van, a religious sect of Skrulls leading an invasion of Earth. Alex and the team had a final showdown with the Skrulls in Central Park. The heroes won and the Skrulls were banished from Earth. After the battle Alex and the team struggled to deal with the fallout of the invasion. ===Hydra=== Fury's Secret Warriors were sent to an old S.H.I.E.L.D. base in Texas to observe activity there. They discovered Hydra operatives there. In defiance of their orders to observe only, Slingshot, The Druid, and Stonewall engaged the terrorists. After joining the team, Phobos bonded with the others over dinner and told them their futures. Among the predictions he made were Slingshot losing her arms, and the death of Hellfire. Despite telling Hellfire that he was going to die, they became friends. When the Secret Warriors arrived at S.H.I.E.L.D. base Red Worm, they saw the Kraken, and a revived Gorgon executing agents. They attacked and even Phobos is unable to use his powers against him, but they are able to escape. J.T. Slade went through Fury's stuff, but was found by Phobos. Instead of stopping him, he helped him. They both manage to find were Fury keeps his Life Model Decoy. When J.T. and Phobos were on monitor duty. Then they intercept a message from Black Widow, requesting immediate extraction much to their joy. The team are attacked by the Dark Avengers and H.A.M.M.E.R. But working together they are able to escape. ===Judged by the Gods=== A conflict occurred ages ago between both Olympians and Japanese gods, Zeus and Amatsu-Mikaboshi both asked a blind blacksmith to forge weapons for them. Thus, the blacksmith forged the swords Godkiller and Grasscutter respectively for the two gods. The latter was given to Alexander to kill his father Ares. thumb|right|300px|Phobos celebrating with Ares after being accepted by the Godheads He managed to get around the brainwashing Mikaboshi inflicted on him and realized what he had done. Eleven months later in Burkina Faso, Ares and Alex debated over the issues of war, good and evil and honor. Fury met with Ares, asking for his help in breaking into Avengers Tower. In exchange, he promised the God of War to bring his son for judgement before the other gods. He did and Ares brought his son to another plane of existence, where he was given back his samurai armor and Grasscutter, stained with Ares' blood. Phobos was told that he would be judged before Balder the Brave, Hera and Quetzalcoatl. He was eventually found worthy of the title God of Fear because he showed none. As the gods celebrated, Ares told Phobos that he was not a god or demigod and that to become a true god, his son must die so that he may one day be reborn. In Providence, Fury Secret Base #21, the team played cards. When both he and Hellfire made unhappy comments towards Quake for dismissing Druid, she admitted that Fury didn't think he was good enough. However, Stonewall was completely opposed to this, commenting about how seeing his father reminded him of how damaged and alone he'd been. But because of Fury, they all had a purpose and they should be

alexander apex.name: Alexander Apex
alexander apex.origin: Alexander Apex was a gambler who used his telepathic abilities to hustle casinos all over the world, reading the minds of his opponents to defeat them. He was eventually caught in a casino in Macau, China, and given the choice to either be disposed of in the middle of the ocean, or work for them. From then on, Apex began playing secretly in behalf of the casino, to ensure they didn't lose any money by winning every tournament. Apex met his most challenging rival when Matt Murdock entered a tournament under the alias of "Laurent Levasseur" and made it to the final. Murdock's blindness prevented Apex from seeing Matt's cards, and his psychic defenses protected him from Apex's mental attacks. Both rivals eventually battled both with cards and minds. In the end, Apex lost both confrontations, and got knocked out due to the strain.
powers: Alexander Apex is a telepath. The extent and origin of his abilities are both unknown.

alexander cady.name: Alexander Cady
alexander cady.origin: Alexander Cady was a member of the reinstituted Red Room, which had relocated in America. He was behind the cloning program that resulted in the creation of a clone of the Black Widow following her death at the hands of Captain America. Cady became the handler of Black Widow's clone following her creation, though he was unaware she retained all of the original Widow's memories, since Red Room agent Ursa Major secretly interfered in the process that was supposed to give her only a selected few of the original Natasha Romanoff's memories. On Alexander's behalf, Black Widow targeted the remnants of both Hydra and S.H.I.E.L.D.. Black Widow eventually found out about the Red Room's cloning program and that she was a clone herself, and started working against her handlers. After faking the death of her latest target, former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Sally Blevins, Black Widow approached Alexander at his home in Second Avenue and killed him. She pinned the murder on the Winter Soldier by leaving at the scene of the crime a mark that served as his calling card from his time in the Red Room. Alexander's body was found not long after his death by the Winter Soldier and Hawkeye, who had been investigating the Black Widow's sightings and were looking into her supposed return.

alexander ellis.name: Alexander Ellis
alexander ellis.origin: Alex Ellis grew up idolizing heroes like Spider-Man and Fantastic Four, and decided that joining the army would be his best chance of being like them. In the Gulf War, he earned the Purple Heart for dragging his comrade David Dunson out of a war zone while his leg was severely wounded. Unfortunately, David did not survive the War. Once he was back stateside, Alex campaigned for wounded veterans to get more advanced prosthetics for those who lost limbs in combat. He was offered a part in an experiment to give him back his leg for his heroism. Unbeknownst to him, the man who was offering this "gift" was Abner Dunson, father of the comrade Alex pulled to safety. Mr. Dunson somehow blamed Alex for his son's death. Mr. Dunson planned to erase Alex's memory and replace it with that of his son's using the Annex technology. Something went wrong and Alex, now transformed into more machine than man, went on a rampage. Spider-Man happened along Annex's rampage and attempted to stop him. Along with some regained memory of his own, Annex used Spider-Man's help to bring Mr. Dunson to justice. After the Civil War, he was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative, and was recruited for training, even though he already had military training, and was active as a hero for quite a while. After the Skrull invasion, Annex was assigned to New Mexico's Initiative team, the Mavericks.

alexander flynn.name: Alexander Flynn
alexander flynn.origin: thumb|left|250px Alexander Flynn was allegedly the son of the Latverian dictator Victor Von Doom and an unidentified Latverian Romani woman. Flynn was apparently presented to Doom as his son, but the dictator refused to recognize him as such and exiled both the boy and his mother. Once he was an adult, Flynn turned up in Los Angeles, California, where he was recruited by Hugo Longride to work as a talent scout for the Underground Mutant Theatre, an organization that staged fights between mutant combatants for its audience's amusement. Flynn approached Dazzler to recruit her for the theater. Dazzler had recently been publicly exposed as a mutant was feeling sad and lonely due to the current state of her entertainment career, agreed to try it. Flynn began plying Dazzler with drugs in order to keep her compliant to his will. Dazzler began to take part in fights as one of the Gladiators in the Underground Mutant Theatre, with much success at first. thumb|left|200px Flynn then tried to use Dazzler and the other Gladiators in an attempt to usurp his boss Hugo Longride's position as leader of the group. The Gladiators sided with Flynn, and killed Longride. Flynn then imprisoned Dazzler and her friend the Beast and proceeded with his plan to use his Gladiators to overthrow Doom and become leader of Latveria. Dazzler and Beast escaped, however, and along with some of the Gladiators who switched allegiance, defeated Flynn. Flynn was almost choked to death by a young mutant named Link. The Gladiators turned on him and decided to follow one of their number, Rocker, instead, leaving Flynn bereft. Subsequently, Flynn was seen to return and take control of the Gladiators once again. However, this Flynn was secretly the telepathic mutant the Shadow King, who was at that time in possession of the body of Karma of the New Mutants, who created an illusion of Flynn to make it seem like Flynn was still in control. Farouk as Flynn forced the New Mutants Sunspot and Magma to join the Gladiators and fight in their arena by saying he would force some runaway teenagers to fight if they did not. fields.occupation: Leader of the Underground Mutant Theatre
fields.history: thumb|left|250px Alexander Flynn was allegedly the son of the Latverian dictator Victor Von Doom and an unidentified Latverian Romani woman. Flynn was apparently presented to Doom as his son, but the dictator refused to recognize him as such and exiled both the boy and his mother. Once he was an adult, Flynn turned up in Los Angeles, California, where he was recruited by Hugo Longride to work as a talent scout for the Underground Mutant Theatre, an organization that staged fights between mutant combatants for its audience's amusement. Flynn approached Dazzler to recruit her for the theater. Dazzler had recently been publicly exposed as a mutant was feeling sad and lonely due to the current state of her entertainment career, agreed to try it. Flynn began plying Dazzler with drugs in order to keep her compliant to his will. Dazzler began to take part in fights as one of the Gladiators in the Underground Mutant Theatre, with much success at first. thumb|left|200px Flynn then tried to use Dazzler and the other Gladiators in an attempt to usurp his boss Hugo Longride's position as leader of the group. The Gladiators sided with Flynn, and killed Longride. Flynn then imprisoned Dazzler and her friend the Beast and proceeded with his plan to use his Gladiators to overthrow Doom and become leader of Latveria. Dazzler and Beast escaped, however, and along with some of the Gladiators who switched allegiance, defeated Flynn. Flynn was almost choked to death by a young mutant named Link. The Gladiators turned on him and decided to follow one of their number, Rocker, instead, leaving Flynn bereft. Subsequently, Flynn was seen to return and take control of the Gladiators once again. However, this Flynn was secretly the telepathic mutant the Shadow King, who was at that time in possession of the body of Karma of the New Mutants, who created an illusion of Flynn to make it seem like Flynn was still in control. Farouk as Flynn forced the New Mutants Sunspot and Magma to join the Gladiators and fight in their arena by saying he would force some runaway teenagers to fight if they did not. The false Flynn was defeated by the New Mutants, Shadowcat, and Rachel Summers. The real Flynn's current status and whereabouts are unknown.

alexander power pseudoplasm.name: Alexander Power (Pseudoplasm)
alexander power pseudoplasm.origin: Following the destruction of Kymellia II, the Technocrat hatched a plot to destroy the new homeworld of the Kymellians, Kymellia III. The Technocrat had once been the "behind the scenes puppet master" of the artificial satellite that had once housed the Kymellians. With their relocation to a planet, he had lost all power. Believing the most efficient means to destroy the new world (and force the Kymellian people to move to a new artificial world where he would, again, be in control), he kidnapped Dr. James Power to use his memories to build a matter/antimatter converter to destroy the planet. To avoid detection, he also abducted Power’s wife, Margaret. He used "pseudoplasm replacements" to impersonate the Powers to avoid detection by their children, the youthful heroes known as Power Pack. When the eldest child, Alex, began to suspect his parents, he was also replaced. Unfortunately for the Technocrat, flaws in the "pseudoplasm replacements" began to manifest. Both parents began acting out of character. "Alex" began losing his hair and soon reverted to his base Kymellian form while also developing additional powers. When Julie realized there was something wrong, the Technocrat had all of Power Pack captured. The team was able to stop his plans and the replacements were destroyed.

alexander ryking.name: Alexander Ryking
alexander ryking.origin: Alexander Ryking worked at the Alamogordo Nuclear Research facility alongside Brian Xavier and Kurt Marko. When his son Carter's mutant powers first manifested themselves, Alexander placed him under heavy sedation because the power was uncontrollable. Unfortunately, no measures to cure or assist Carter worked, and he spent most of his life under tranquilizers. Carter and Brian Xavier's son Charles Xavier were both experimented on by Mister Sinister who injected them with his own DNA. Years later, when Carter saw a news report of his father's death, he went berserk and lashed out with his powers. Wearing a battle-suit at his father's funeral, Carter, now calling himself Hazard, attacked his father's funeral and taunted Professor Charles Xavier.

alexander schrott.name: Alexander Schrott
alexander schrott.origin: The Gorilla Man was forced to work for the King of Castle Island after his family was kidnapped and held hostage. His main task was to capture people and bring them to the king so he could infect them. One of his captives escaped and the Gorilla Man as sent to retrieve her, which brought the Angel to the island. The Angel is captured, breaks free, and is stopped by the Gorilla Man. The king orders him tossed off the cliff, the ape-man tells the Angel that there is a ledge and a cavern passage along the cliffs face. The Angel returns and manages to remove the key from the kings possession and hands it over to the Gorilla Man, winning his loyalty. When the king prepared to surrender, the Gorilla Man forced him to swallow his poison pill killing him instantly. The Gorilla Man freed his family and thanked the Angel for his assistance.

alexander walsh.name: Alexander Walsh
alexander walsh.origin: thumb|left|Hard-as-nails police captain Walsh reprimands his men Los Angeles Police Department Captain Alexander Walsh was a hard-boiled, veteran policeman with an office in the eight floor of the Los Angeles Police Headquarters. He often worked with his subordinate Jacobi. When Spider-Woman started working as a bounty hunter in Los Angeles, Walsh became her contact in the police. She delivered captured criminals to Walsh, often entering his office through the window and leaving the crooks bound and gagged, along with evidence to process their arrest. As part of her style, Spider-Woman would wait in Walsh's office with the lights off to surprise him and, after debriefing him, she would leave through the window, sometimes mid-conversation, crawling along the wall in a way that Walsh found creepily weird. Spider-Woman and Walsh agreed on a way for her to collect the reward: Walsh would send her to a blind box, so she did not have to reveal her secret identity to him (although he more than once showed an interest for her true name). At that time, Spider-Woman had formed a partnership with criminologist Scotty McDowell, who knew about Walsh. This relationship was satisfactory for Walsh, since, as Spider-Woman's contact, Walsh got some of the prestige of capturing these thugs, who had often managed to outwit the police. thumb|right|Spider-Woman captured criminals for Walsh and theatrically left them in his office as a surprise. In that situation, Spider-Woman handed over the thief Lou DeFalco and his gang to Walsh, just as the jeweler's association had doubled the reward for the gang to $20,000; Walsh's men had been unable find DeFalco and the gang, locating only their getaway car, broken (from the fight when Spider-Woman caught them). Walsh acknowledged to Spider-Woman that the reward was higher than anticipated, but also attempted to remove her mask; she stopped him with a mild bioelectric burst, and after a brief conversation, she left. Possibly she next handed, shortly afterwards, the criminals who had tried to attack the ship Regency III to Walsh; and perhaps to the serial murderer Killer Clown, for who there was no reward but whom she caught pro bono. thumb|right|In a convoluted operation, Walsh and his men apprehended the Gamesman I and I, with Spider-Woman's help. Shortly after, Walsh searched in vain for clues to catch strategic crime lord the Gamesman, not knowing that the Gamesman was spying on the police through the cleaner Marsha. The Gamesman impressed the police because his heists were specially prepared and had a lot of information, including a theft of paintings at the Los Angeles County Art Museum. Jacobi put Harris and Stevens on the case; and after an unsatisfactory debriefing, Walsh found out the thieves, and the stolen paintings, waiting in his office along with Spider-Woman. Walsh jokingly suggested that Spider-Woman seek out the Gamesman, believing it would be too much for her. On the other side of the door, Marsha listened and informed the Gamesman, allowing the Gamesman to set up an ambush against Spider-Woman when she left the police station. This allowed the Gamesman to seduce and manipulate Spider-Woman; despite this, Spider-Woman and McDowell managed to get the Gamesman arrested. Even in prison, the Gamesman continued to take advantage Spider-Woman, convincing her to request early parole for him. She met with Walsh to propose it, appealing to the difficult life the Gamesman had had. Walsh not only rejected the idea completely, but said he would have suspended any of his men who had asked for something like that. Walsh told Spider-Woman that he respected her, since she had shown guts and talent, and he would even like her to be a police officer, and thus he told her that she should avoid falling in love with criminals like she had done. Once again, Marsha overheard the conversation and warned the new Gamesman, so he could also attack Spider-Woman. After the first Gamesman escaped with the help of Spider-Woman, she initiated a complex operation to be taken to the Gamesman's lair, the Situation Room, defeat the new Gamesman and obtain evidence against both Gamesmen. She had kept Walsh in the loop so that the police would appear at the right time to arrest them all. Once the first Gamesman proved to still be a criminal, Walsh showed up with his people and had Jacobi arrest him, while other police arrested the rest. alexander woolcot.origin: Alexander Woolcot is the son of a research scientist, Fritz Woolcot, who would regularly beat him, especially if Alex interrupted his experiments. One of Alex's teachers saw bruises on the boy and threatened to report Alex's father to the authorities, but Alex's father threatened to claim that the teacher had been abusing Alex. One day, Alex felt himself drawn to one of his father's machines, and put his hand into some glowing energy that was emanating from it, which gave him a shock and exploded, much to Fritz's anger. Alex's teacher showed up with a reporter, Joy Mercado, from the Daily Bugle to expose Fritz's abuse. Fritz struck the teacher, and the stress caused energy to build up inside Alex after his accident. The energy build-up was sensed by the hero Spider-Man, who tried to intervene, only to find the tingle suddenly vanished. Later, Alex's father tried to beat him, but the energy build-up within Alex was released and he disintegrated his father, leaving only a pile of ash. Distraught, Alex fled his home for the streets of New York City. On the streets, a pedophile tried to abduct Alex, but fled when Alex blew up a car and an electricity generator with his power, causing a blackout. When a pair of police officers approached him, Alex exploded their car, and the cops reported a mutant attack, drawing the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D.. Worried about him, Alex's teacher contacted the Daily Bugle, hoping that its photographer Peter Parker could contact Spider-Man (not knowing that Parker himself was actually Spider-Man). Spider-Man found Alex, who attacked him using his powers attracting the attention of a group of S.H.I.E.L.D. Mandroid who tried to capture Alex, but were opposed by Spider-Man and Alex. They beat the Mandroids, but Alex was subsequently gunned down by a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and seemingly killed. However, Alex was actually shot with tranquilizers and taken in by S.H.I.E.L.D., who placed him in protective care in Colorado, with a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent posing as his father. Alex's mental health was in a precarious state, and he came to believe the agent was his real father. The situation was changed, however, when a rogue S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, Clay Quartermain broke in to the house to use the agent's computer to track some gamma bombs. Quartermain and his allies Bruce Banner and Rick Jones overpowered the agent posing as Alex's father, but when they surprised Alex, he blasted Banner with his power, causing him great pain despite the fact he was in his super-strong Hulk form at the time. The Hulk was enraged, but calmed towards Alex when he found out about his abusive father, a situation Banner empathized with. Then, Alex realized the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent wasn't his real father. After their brief heart-to-heart, Hulk returned Alex to his adoptive father, who swore to care for him.

alexandra draguno.name: Alexandra Draguno
alexandra draguno.origin: Alexandra Draguno (Russian: Александра Драгуно) trained to be an exoskeleton pilot in the Black Academy, an elite school founded to fight American super-soldiers. She got the highest ratings ever, and she created new techniques for piloting suits. She ended working in an exoskeleton for a Russian nuclear power plant. She was approached by Arthur, who offered to make her his "Lancelot" in his technological brotherhood called The Circle. She became one of the Circle's best members and trained their new soldiers. During an auction run by A.I.M., the Circle bought part of the replicated Extremis technology, creating new and better exoskeletons for their own purposes. After they noticed Iron Man was searching for the Extremis which A.I.M. stole, Arthur proposed Stark a wager: if Stark defeated the Circle's Extremis-enhanced pilots, he would be free to retrieve the Extremis. When Lancelot fought him, Stark lost on purpose only to get the chance to destroy their Extremis sample, which was being protected by a light-permeable force field, using a potent U.V. laser, thus the Circle lost all the Extremis they had left and were unable to continue producing new technologies. Even though the Circle lost the Extremis, Lancelot felt that she won, by demonstrating her superiority against Iron Man as a pilot. When the powerful material Phlogistone was found in the Moon, the Circle was sent to Tranquility Gulch, the human colony from which the Phlogistone was studied, as representatives of Symkaria. They later helped Iron Man attack the embassy of the country of their common enemy, Doctor Doom, in an attempt to prevent any Phlogistone from reaching Doom's hands. Later Lancelot was with her fellow Circle members who threatened to arrest X-Force for the theft of stolen goods in Aniana. They ended up in a battle against Cannonball and Shatterstar when the two refused.
powers: Extremis-enhanced
abilities: Very skilled in piloting the Knight-Suit, to the point of only using its thrusters and "lance" of anti-repulsor power in her style, rather than as weapons of their own.

alexandra feodorovna.name: Alexandra Feodorovna
alexandra feodorovna.origin: Alexandra Feodorovna was Empress of Russia as the spouse of Nicholas II, the last ruler of the Russian Empire. Grigory Rasputin was introduced to Czar Nicholas II and his wife, Alexandra, who were seeking help for their sickly son, Alexei. Rasputin quickly gained their confidence by seemingly "curing" the boy of haemophilia. This action won him the passionate support of Alexandra. In 1912, after a fall, Alexei began bleeding uncontrollably. The doctors could do nothing for him, but Rasputin, with a wave of his hands, stopped the flow of blood. After that he took a number of lovers and engaged in quasi-religious rituals with all these women. ===Russian Revolution=== Nicholas II abdicated and they were exiled to the Siberian city of Yekaterinburg. On July 17, 1918, with the anti-communist White Army closing in on the city, the former Tsar, his wife Tsarina Alexandra, and their five children were all executed by Bolshevik soldiers.

alexandra macready.name: Alexandra Macready
alexandra macready.origin: Agent Alexandra Macready was a government agent of the US Department of Justice and a member of the secret group of Grover Lane formed by the three agents who ate an alien as a meal that gave them powers but drove them crazy. The group was tasked with capturing the international thief Fantomex after Agent Rhona Flemyng's multiple failed attempts. The madness of the Grover Lane members, however, led to devise a form of blackmail that led them to kidnap the agent Flemyng to force Fantomex to steal a key that would activate a laser system designed to vaporize a comet aimed at the Earth so as to be able to keep the population of the Earth being held hostage only for money, but the leader of the group, Stuart Stirling, completely out of control by madness, was planning to destroy entire communities with the laser. When Macready reminded Stirling that the plan was to laser only the landmarks to get money, Stirling killed her by expelling her heart from her chest.

alexandra reid.name: Alexandra Reid
alexandra reid.origin: ===Origin=== The woman later known as Alexandra was born centuries, maybe millenia ago. During her "first life", she had a daughter, who passed away at a young age. Lost and looking for answers about life and death itself, she eventually found her way to K'un-Lun. Alongside four others, she was banished because of their search for immortality. Together, they became the five fingers of The Hand. Alexandra was the chief officer of The Hand, handling business deals and manipulating governments. left|thumb|280px In the early 21st century, Alexandra was diagnosed with terminal cancer, and without more "Substance" she was finally facing death. In a final attempt to save herself, she used the last remaining stores of the "Substance" to resurrect the Black Sky and gathered the fingers of The Hand. Together they worked to undercover a dragon skeleton under Manhattan. Facing dissension among The Hand and opposition from the Defenders and Stick, Alexandra was unceremoniously murdered by Elektra and decapitated post-mortem to prevent resurrection.

alexandria knox.name: Alexandria Knox
alexandria knox.origin: thumb|left|150px Alexandria Knox was a scientist affiliated with Soul Star Research, involved in the study and containment of the electrical entity Zzzax. During an early recreation of the being, Zzzax absorbed Stan Landers, whose emotional attachment to Knox influenced the entity’s actions. As a result, Zzzax abducted Knox and engaged the Hulk, before Mark Revel dispersed the entity using a copper wire and a lightning storm. Knox survived due to Landers’ intervention and ultimate sacrifice. Sometime afterward, Zzzax rematerialized during a meltdown at a new Illinois Edison breeder reactor and abducted Knox once again. Intending to convert her into an electrical being like itself, Zzzax began preparing a molecular transformer. Knox was rescued when her recent acquaintance, Power Man, intervened. Their battle destroyed the transformer and caused Zzzax to dissipate once more.

alexandrina victoria.name: Alexandrina Victoria
alexandrina victoria.first_appearance: Further Adventures of Cyclops and Phoenix Vol 1 4
alexandrina victoria.origin: Queen Victoria was the ruler of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland as well as the vast British Empire from 1837 until her death in 1901. This time in the 19th century was known as the Victorian Era. During her life she was the wielder of the Amulet of Pazuzu. Apocalypse went to Buckingham Palace to kill Queen Victoria. She and her husband Prince Albert were talking to Prime Minister William Gladstone about the Irish problem. He interrupted them telling them to raze the country to the ground killing everyone, problem solved. Gladstone demanded to know who he was and he killed two of the guards with a click of his fingers. He released a blast at the Queen and her husband when it was deflected by the time travelling Jean Grey. Cyclops knocked him away with his eye beams, he teleported away when Mr. Sinister arrived to warn him. Queen Victoria demanded to know what just happened but Jean simply erased everyone's memory.

alexei ganger.name: Alexei Ganger
alexei ganger.origin: Ganger was a scientist who worked alongside Phillip Masters (Puppet Master) and Jacob Reiss who became disillusioned with his work. Ganger hoped to bring an age of enlightenment, discovery and utopic peace to the Earth through science but instead saw it used for greater and greater weapons. Ganger would go on to lose his wife and later be struck with multiple sclerosis. When Ganger witnessed the Silver Surfer's first arrival on Earth it was a religious experience for him and he began to view the Surfer as a messianic figure. Ganger surrounded himself with scientists and philosophers who believed as he did and who also came to worship the Surfer. Ganger's granddaughter Sorrentino was one of the disciples and worked as his right hand alongside an army of biotechnic clones, the Gangers, to locate the Surfer after he returned to Earth. Ganger revealed his worship of the Surfer to a kidnapped Phillip Masters shortly before said kidnapping lured the Surfer in. Ganger and his granddaughter revealed their worship of the Surfer to him who declined their wish to act as their messiah. Ganger then had his Gangers attack the Surfer who was in a delicate emotional state and reacted with rage and violence. After the Surfer accidentally injured Masters and healed him, leading Masters to remark he had 'seen the light' and would change his ways, Ganger and his people became even more certain that the Surfer was a messiah, believing that the Surfer had raised Masters from the dead. The Surfer was still reluctant to be seen as any kind of messiah but Alicia Masters encouraged him to try and help the world, using his abilities the Surfer bathed the Earth in quantum energies which allowed every person alive to feel absolute peace, acceptance and love. Ganger and his people then recovered the Surfer after he fell into the ocean exhausted and welcomed Masters into their fold as he sought to atone for his sins. After the Surfer left them, Ganger revealed to Masters that their 'attack' on the Surfer had in fact been a cover to siphon some of the Power Cosmic from the Surfer, Ganger planned to have Masters help him create their own messiah now that the Surfer had refused them. Ganger then had Masters use his Psychic Clay to mold a statue which was then brought to life with the Surfers stolen energies and became the Cosmic Messiah. Ganger then had the Messiah programmed with the history of humanity and brought Alicia Masters to behold him and nurture the humanity within him as she done with the Surfer years before. Instead the Cosmic Messiah reduced him to energy alongside of the rest of the inhabitants of Satori before being reconstituted.
weaknesses: Suffers from multiple sclerosis

alexei romanov.name: Alexei Romanov
alexei romanov.origin: Alexei Romanov was a boy Ava Orlova frequently dreamed about while living on the streets of Brooklyn, although she did not know whom he was. Going by the foster name, Alex Manor, he was later revealed to be the younger brother of Black Widow super spy Natasha Romanoff, born in Stalingrad during the fall of the Soviet Union. After Natasha started to work at S.H.I.E.L.D., she wiped both their memories during Project: Blank Slate, gave Alexei his new foster name, and assigned a fellow Agent to go undercover as his foster mother and take care of him under the alias Marilyn Manor. Alex started fencing not long after, where met the equally competitive Dante Cruz, and in no time they were inseparable best friends, getting into a series of stupid fights, such as arm wrestling during Dante’s sister's Christmas Party. During their last tournament together, Alex met Ava Orlova and reunited with his sister the Black Widow, though they did not know they were siblings due to the previous mind wipe. Later, when he and Ava escaped the Triskelion and fled to Ukraine, Alex discovered his true identity and past, then finally understood where all those nightmares had come from and why he had woken up with a mysterious hourglass-shaped tattoo. Sadly after Alexei reunited with his sister, he passed away soon after during a mission for S.H.I.E.L.D. to Sultanahmet where the trio battled with Ivan Somorodov beneath Istanbul, Turkey. Alex left behind his fencing swords, which were claimed by his girlfriend, the Red Widow. fields.history: Alexei Romanov was a boy Ava Orlova frequently dreamed about while living on the streets of Brooklyn, although she did not know whom he was. Going by the foster name, Alex Manor, he was later revealed to be the younger brother of Black Widow super spy Natasha Romanoff, born in Stalingrad during the fall of the Soviet Union. Alex started fencing not long after, where met the equally competitive Dante Cruz, and in no time they were inseparable best friends, getting into a series of stupid fights, such as arm wrestling during Dante’s sister's Christmas Party. During their last tournament together, Alex met Ava Orlova and reunited with his sister the Black Widow, though they did not know they were siblings due to the previous mind wipe. Later, when he and Ava escaped the Triskelion and fled to Ukraine, Alex discovered his true identity and past, then finally understood where all those nightmares had come from and why he had woken up with a mysterious hourglass-shaped tattoo. alexi garnoff.name: Alexi Garnoff
alexi garnoff.origin: Under the Soviet government, all of the communist states viewed mutants as a threat to humanity's survival. As such, mutants were forced to band together in subversive hideaways in an elaborate safehouse system. Blind Faith, the Catholic priest Father Alexi Garnoff, was the leader of one of these cells, whose membership included Mentac, Concussion, Iron Curtain, and Siberian Tiger (later known as Sibercat). A German member of the KGB named Wolfgang Heinrich, also known as the Doppelganger, was capturing and vivisecting mutants. When the original X-Factor team came to the USSR to investigate, Doppelganger captured Iceman and posed as him. Garnoff and Iron Curtain rescued Iceman, who helped these exiles raid the Doppelganger's facility and with X-Factor brought the mutants to safety. The cyborg assassin, Firefox, under orders from Project: Remont soon infiltrated the safehouses looking for mutant runaways. He brutally killed many mutants until Blind Faith called for the abandonment of the safehouse system and escaped with five other mutants, Vanguard, Darkstar, Ursa Major, Sibercat, and Stencil. Mentac, Concussion, and Iron Curtain were not so fortunate, as they were killed by Firefox. Garnoff saw the need for a mutant freedom fighting force to undertake dangerous missions and organized the surviving mutants into a team called the Exiles, dedicated to fighting for the rights of other Russian mutants. In one such mission, Blind Faith and Darkstar encountered an immensely powerful psychic being, the Soul Skinner, who had taken over a small Russian town. With the help of the X-Men, the Soul Skinner was defeated. Garnoff was also once the leader of an incarnation of the Russian superteam formerly known as the Soviet Super-Soldiers, now known as the Winter Guard. Later Blind Faith lost his mutant powers after the event known as M-Day.

alexi jaeger.name: Alexi Jaeger
alexi jaeger.origin: Alexi Jaeger was a Bio-Shop mercenary, genetically augmented to manipulate light. Beautiful on the outside but twisted on the inside, Alexi has a relationship with the DeGen Rosalinda Vasquez before she realized his true self. Rosa and her friends in the Freakshow escaped the Bio-Shops with Mama Hurricane after Rosa became pregnant by Alexi. In his role as Glitterspike, Alexi tracked the Freakshow down at a Keewazi reservation and kidnapped Rosa. Rosa's new boyfriend, Metalhead, went out with Mama to rescue her, but everyone was surprised to run into the old Keewazi legend, the Shadow Dancer. Glitterspike confronted the Dancer in an underground cavern, mistakenly exhausting his photovoltaic powers in the dark. Metalhead and the Freakshow left Alexi to the Dancer's mercies. Glitterspike lost an arm fighting the Shadow Dancer, but eventually escaped and tried to take Rosa again just as she went into labor. Miraculously, the unborn baby itself struck out from the womb to prevent Alexi from harming his mother.

alexi kalishnikov.origin: Alexi Kalishnikov was a ruthless agent who worked for the KGB. He was responsible for the coming of "The Dawning Light". On an island, Samisdat realized his plan to lead "The Dawning Light" as terrorists to fight against western civilization. However, his plans were suddenly destroyed by Shang-Chi, Leiko Wu, Jack Tarr, and Clive Reston. Not willing to give up, he tried to send his five new agents, including Syn, to stand against them but they all failed. As a last desperate attempt, he tried to activate his satellite and escape in it, but Reston had destroyed the satellite, and Samisdat was killed when the satellite crashed down on him.

alexus.name: Alexus
alexus.species: Magical creation; prophesized High Priest of Set
alexus.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age (18,500 BC)=== During the Age of Kull, a sect of Set worshipers known as the Unliving tried to fulfill a prophecy. They sacrificed five woman, then abducted a sixth which they magically impregnated in order to spawn a son that would rise as High Priest of Set, an immensely powerful being that would rule all. As the woman gave birth to twin sister and brother, the Unliving saw blasphemy and slew the mother. Kull arrived instant later, slew the sorcerers, and had his councilor Tu drown the infants, but he entrusted them in the care of a shepherd who had lost his only son. ===Hyborian Age (10,000 BC)=== Growing through 8000 years, into the Hyborian Age of Conan, Alexus lived with his twin sister Narcia in Tarsus in the Border Kingdoms. Alexus himself also dwelt in Castle Alexus, in the hills beyond Tarsus. Though unrelated to the King's family, Narcia became known as the White Queen. Allying himself with Castrica, sorceress and princess of Tarsus, Alexus discovered that he was the prophesied High Priest of Set and came into conflict with Conan. Narcia finally slew Alexus, thus allowing him to ascend to greater power. As Alexus was growing too powerful, destroying his castle and killing Castrica, Conan was forced to kill Alexus' twin sister, allowing her to ascend as well, so that her soul could thwart Alexus' power for all eternity.

aleytys forrester.name: Aleytys Forrester
aleytys forrester.origin: Aleytys Forrester met Scott Summers after he quit the X-Men and signed-on as member of the crew of her fishing trawler after his long-time love Jean Grey died. Lee helped Scott work through his grief. After an adventure in which Lee's father Jock Forrester was possessed by D'Spayre and committed suicide, Scott and the Man-Thing fought D'Spayre. Lee and Scott were shipwrecked in the Bermuda Triangle, where they found Magneto's Island M. Scott lost his visor and was powerless when they soon met Magneto, but he aided the X-Men in defeating Magneto. Lee fell in love with Scott. Scott returned to see her after spending months in space with the X-Men. Lee told Scott that his superhero life terrified her and that he would have to choose between her and the X-Men. They parted on good terms and Scott met Madelyne Pryor, a pilot who looked identical to Jean. Scott did not return to Lee and soon married Madelyne. The alien Warlock crashed through Magneto's Asteroid M, sending it plummeting to Earth. Magneto landed in the ocean, where he was saved from a shark attack by Lee. Lee took Magneto to his old base in the Bermuda Triangle and nursed him back to health, despite his mutant-supremacist ideology. The two became lovers, but on the following day, Lee was reminded that Magneto was a supervillain and left him. Lee was impersonated by Mystique when Freedom Force was apprehending Magneto. The X-Men found Lee, but Magneto surrendered to Freedom Force to stand trial. Lee met Cable, whom she seemed to like too, but nothing further developed between them. Lee Forrester was reunited with Cable and the X-Men when her ship was trapped by a hurricane. ===Scorpius=== Lee captained an expedition to an alternate dimension, led by George Stanislaus, that was stranded when their ship ran aground. After the Future Foundation found a distress call from Lee and James Scully, they learned that they were trapped in the dimension—where time moved faster than in the mainstream reality—and enlisted the X-Men and Magneto to rescue them. After arriving, the heroes learned that Lee had allied with a local tribe. The Scorpius attacked and subjugated the locals, and planned to invade the mainstream reality; another tribe, the Kaddak, was a possible ally and Lee attempted to negotiate a treaty. Lee was reunited with Scott, which his new girlfriend Emma Frost disliked, and with the help of the heroes Lee and Scully defeated the Scorpius. After a power source was found to return them to the mainstream reality, Lee and Scully—who had fallen in love—decided to stay and safeguard the power source.

The two became lovers, but on the following day, Lee was reminded that Magneto was a supervillain and left him. Lee was impersonated by Mystique when Freedom Force was apprehending Magneto. The X-Men found Lee, but Magneto surrendered to Freedom Force to stand trial. Lee met Cable, whom she seemed to like too, but nothing further developed between them. Lee Forrester was reunited with Cable and the X-Men when her ship was trapped by a hurricane. ===Scorpius=== Lee captained an expedition to an alternate dimension, led by George Stanislaus, that was stranded when their ship ran aground. After the Future Foundation found a distress call from Lee and James Scully, they learned that they were trapped in the dimension—where time moved faster than in the mainstream reality—and enlisted the X-Men and Magneto to rescue them. After arriving, the heroes learned that Lee had allied with a local tribe. The Scorpius attacked and subjugated the locals, and planned to invade the mainstream reality; another tribe, the Kaddak, was a possible ally and Lee attempted to negotiate a treaty. Lee was reunited with Scott, which his new girlfriend Emma Frost disliked, and with the help of the heroes Lee and Scully defeated the Scorpius. After a power source was found to return them to the mainstream reality, Lee and Scully—who had fallen in love—decided to stay and safeguard the power source.

alfeo spinosa.name: Alfeo Spinosa
alfeo spinosa.origin: Alfeo Spinosa was an Italian Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the curator of the Vatican's San Gabriel Archives. Stephen Strange considered Alfeo to be one of his oldest friends but nothing has been revealed about when and how they first met. After discovering that the San Gabriel Archives had just been robbed by Baron Mordo, Cardinal Spinosa decided that he had to warn his old friend. After travelling aboard TWA Flight 666 from Rome to New York City, Spinosa attempted to call Strange from Kennedy Airport but he and his disciple Clea had just left. Fearing that his friend would be vulnerable to a sneak attack as long as he remained unaware of Mordo's crime, Spinosa took a taxi to the Sanctum Sanctorum, let himself in and was waiting in the parlor when Strange and Clea returned. Strange welcomed his friend but Spinosa immediately revealed that he was there on business and showed him a picture of Baron Mordo robbing the San Gabriel Archives the previous day. Spinosa accompanied Strange and Clea as they went to the upstairs room where the catatonic Mordo had been living for months. Spinosa was surprised to see that Mordo was there but Strange, thanks to the photo, now knew that that this Mordo was only an illusion and he immediately dispelled the spirit form. Recalling that one of his old allies, Lord Phyffe, had displayed an unusual interest in Mordo when they had last met, Strange and Spinosa took the first available flight from New York to Paris, France. Upon arrival, they immediately went to Lord Phyffe's home on the right bank of the Seine and entered the unlit mansion through the unlocked front door. Seconds after entering, Strange heard a sound and turned to see Spinosa falling forwards and towards him. Strange attempted to catch him but Spinosa seemingly crumbled into dust in his hands. In that moment of shock, Strange was struck from behind by a cudgel blow to his head that knocked him out. After regaining consciousness, Strange was subjected to various illusions by cultists working for Phyffe and was nearly manipulated into "operating" on a patient. However, after seeing that the "patient" was actually his former lover, Madeleine, Strange was able to break free from the illusion. After accidentally setting the chapel on fire, Strange used his Cloak of Levitation to lift himself and Madeleine out of the house before it collapsed. On the grounds, Strange and Madeleine found Spinosa's dead body, whole but shot through the heart. Strange realized that the disintegration that he had seen had been the actual destruction of his friend's life-force.

alfie.name: Alfie
alfie.origin: Alfie was a young boy from the Bronx who became the sidekick to private detective Mr. Wu in the late 1940s. How Alfie came to be Wu's partner unknown. In 1946, Alfie and Mr. Wu came across the murder of wealthy stamp collector Jackson Cartwright. Alfie assisted Mr. Wu in investigating the murder, often letting his fists fly before thinking the situation out. The pair managed to capture the killer, Cartwright's lawyer Evans, who had forged Cartwright's will so that he would obtain a large sum of money . Later, while attending an opera with Mr. Wu, they stumbled upon the murder of Gino Marino, the opera's tenor. Investigating the murder scene, Dr. Wu and Alfie discovered that the killer was his nephew Peter Barton, who had been forging checks in Gino's name and sought to cover it up by murdering Gino and burning all the evidence .

alfie cullen.name: Alfie Cullen
alfie cullen.origin: Alfie was a member of the Black Cullens crime family. He was present when his father Tommy summoned his cousin Jimmy Pierce proposing to him to become the new Punisher even though Jimmy initially thought the family wanted to eliminate him and so he clashed with all his cousins including Alfie and managed to put them in a corner when Jimmy took hostage his uncle, but Tommy Cullen then revealed his plan to Jimmy and smoothed out the situation. The Black Cullens suffered the assault of Dean Swaybrick and his men killing some members of the Cullens and taking Alfie prisoner. At Alfie's request that he want to make his phone call as was his right, Swaybrick hit him with his weapon and immediately asked him about the Punisher who was paid by the Cullens and where he was. Begging not to be hit again, Alfie revealed Jimmy Pierce's whereabouts and was then killed by Swaybrick with a shot at point-blank range.

alfred gray.name: Alfred Gray
alfred gray.origin: General Alfred Gray was a military officer involved in Reed Richards' rocket project for Aerodyne Corporation. It was Gray who cancelled a rocket test flight, which led to Reed Richards stealing the rocket and causing the accident that created the Fantastic Four. Trying to stop the Fantastic Four from being created, Kang the Conqueror kidnapped and impersonated Gray to authorize the flight. The intended crew included L. Jordan, M. Hermann, and S. Michaels, with the false Gray adding Reed Richards to the list. However, time travelling heroes stopped Kang and rescued Gray, who then revoked the impostor's orders.

alfred jermyn.name: Alfred Jermyn
alfred jermyn.origin: Sir Alfred Jermyn was the only son of Nevil Jermyn and of a "vulgar" dancer with who Nevil had fled in 1849, returning to Jermyn House the following year a widower, with Alfred. In 1852, explorer Samuel Seaton brought proof to Alfred's grandfather Robert Jermyn of the existence of a city of white apes in Congo, which also revealed to Robert his horrific lineage. Robert proceeded to slaughter Seaton, as well as his three sons, including Nevil who managed to protect his two-years old son Alfred. Before he was four, Alfred became a baronet. Alfred was not at ease in the role of nobleman. At twenty, he joined a band of music-hall performer. He married a music-hall performer of unknown origin, and fathered Arthur Jermyn. At the age of 36, he left his wife and son to join a traveling circus in America, "The Greatest Show On Earth". At that time Alfred was fascinated by a circus gorilla of lighter color than average, eventually asking to be able to train him even though he was not prepared for that role. During a stage of the circus in Chicago, Alfred performed a boxing match with the gorilla and was killed by him.

alfred kurt.name: Alfred Kurt
alfred kurt.origin: Professor Alfred Kurt resided on Earth-5391 with his daughter Wanda, it was a universe where advancements in space travel and exploration boomed in the late 20th Century. By the year 2075 Kurt had been locked away in an institution due to his grisly experiments in cutting living creatures in half. Breaking out of the institution, Kurt and his daughter fled to the planet Haydes where the mad scientist quickly took over and perfected his experiments, turning the native humanoid population into his army of Half-Men. When Space Sentinels Speed Carter and Johnny Day explored the planet Haydes, they were captured by the Half-Men and brought before Professor Kurt. Kurt then attempted to repeat his experiments on Carter and Day, but they managed to break free. In the ensuing struggle, Alfred was knocked onto the saw blade that he used to cut his victims in half. Unable to allow his father to die, Wanda performed his Half-Man process on him and saved his life. However it fractured his personality, with one half of his body being his evil side and the other half good. The good half then slew the evil half and repentant of his crimes, turned himself over to Speed and Johnny . His subsequent fate is unknown.

alfred tooks.name: Alfred Tooks
alfred tooks.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 44
alfred tooks.origin: Almost nothing has been revealed about the history of the ganglord known as Black Alfred. Alfred was invited to the funeral of a well known ganglord, Big Louie. During the funeral, Malachi Toomes, who was overseeing the event, announced that his uncle had proclaimed himself the new Kingpin of Crime after Wilson Fisk's retirement. Toomes elaborated that Big Louie failed to recognized his uncle as the new boss, and he was killed because of it. As a way to prove their loyalty, Toome's uncle gave the funeral guests, including Alfred, assignments to steal rare objects to decorate his new headquarters. However, Alfred had no intention of bowing to the mystery man, and instead began working to eliminate other funeral guests in order to eliminate potential competition in his own rise to power. After having his men dispatch of low-rung criminal Harry Dolenz in Chinatown, Alfred had one of his henchmen, Herman, lure Mancini, a rival ganglord, and one of his goons into an ambush at the train tracks. Alfred and two other henchman opened fire, causing Mancini and his man to jump on the train tracks to escape, only to be electrocuted by touching the third rail. Finally eliminating all those he saw as threats, Black Alfred made his way back to the funeral home where Malachi Toomes was staying. When Alfred burst inside, he discovered that Malachi and his uncle, who turned out to be none other than The Vulture, had captured Spider-Man, and chained him to a coffin and were preparing to cremate him alive as a large number of criminals watched. Alfred attacked Malachi and The Vulture, and while the crowd was distracted by the fight, Spider-Man managed to escape. Alfred, Malachi, and The Vulture took their fight to the alley behind the funeral home where Alfred pulled out a handgun and shot Malachi dead. Enraged by witnessing his only relative's murder, The Vulture went into a blind rage and savagely beat Alfred. Spider-Man soon emerged from the funeral home, causing The Vulture to flee. Seeing that Alfred was bloody and beaten, and by no means a threat, Spider-Man left him on the ground and took off to chase down The Vulture. Presumably, Black Alfred was picked up by police and remains in custody.

alfredo chicken.origin: Alfredo the Chicken appeared to be Melissa Morbeck's pet rooster when she showed it to Doreen Green, demonstrating her ability to communicate with animals in the process. In reality, she simply acquired Alfredo to eventually have Chef Bear cook him into a chicken alfredo. While Chef Bear was prepping to cook Alfredo, he escaped. Chef Bear gave chase, but they eventually settled their differences with the help of a lawyer, and fell in love in the process. They married soon afterwards.

alfrigg.name: Alfrigg
alfrigg.origin: During the 23rd cycle of Ragnarok, Alfrigg alongside, Grerr and Dvalin were a trio of Dwarves who were approached by Loki to each forge their best item and present it to Odin. Alfrigg created a sword which would instantly slay a giant whilst Grerr and Dvalin created a necklace that would hypnotize all who gazed upon it and an armband which when tapped would create nine gold coins (who forged which was never identified). Loki bet his head that Odin would pick the necklace in exchange for the other two items. The Dwarves traveled to Asgard the same day as the daughter of the Ice Giant and Odin chose the sword to slay said giant. The Dwarves attempted to claim Loki's head but he managed to convince them that the deal was only for his head and they would be unable to claim just that. The Dwarves returned to Nidavellir, and were later joined by the Enchantress who desired the necklace. They agreed to give to her, in exchange she would have to spend the night with the three of them, which she did so.

algernon black.name: Algernon Black
algernon black.origin: Algernon Black built a house for himself and his young wife Elena in 1888 and painted it all black to discourage anyone from going there as he was obsessively jealous, even forbidding his wife to leave the house. When one day he surprised his wife chatting in the house with a man, taken by a fury that made him mad, he killed the man with his bare hands with his wife who died of shock and terror. After the man's death, Algernon pronounced a curse where he said that no one should enter his house, that his house was forbidden to anyone and whoever entered would die, so that over time the house became one of the haunted places in America. Years later a debunker entered the haunted house and found that Algernon had committed suicide by hanging himself.

algon.name: Algon
algon.origin: Algon was the son of the sorcerer Taboo who tried to turn him into an instrument of power through the use of a spell in the Darkhold. The spell, however, was interrupted halfway through its completion by the citizens of a nearby Transylvanian village led by Jack Russell's father, Gregory Russoff. Algon was grotesquely mutated by the spell but his body was left a mindless husk by the interruption. Taboo was able to escape with his son's body, but was forced to leave behind his copy of the Darkhold which was taken by Gregory who became an expert on the occult. For twenty years Taboo searched for the Darkhold until he found Jack Russell, Werewolf by Night, and with the help of his ward, Topaz, captured him and tried to force him to reveal the location of the Darkhold. As far as Russell knew, the Darkhold had been destroyed months earlier, though Taboo thought he was lying and tried to learn the book's location from Russell's stepfather Philip. During the ensuing struggle between the Werewolf and Taboo, Topaz accidently transferred the consciousness of Phillip Russell into the body of Algon, granting the monstrosity sentience. The Werewolf was able to escape and Jack planned to come back the next night to stop Taboo. Taboo later summoned up the power of Topaz and transferred it to Algon, who obeyed all of Taboo's order, and conferred upon him the power of transmutation which turned everything he touched into gold. After the Werewolf had returned they battled and Algon turned a large statue of Buddha into gold. The statue, however, became too heavy to be supported by its concrete base and it toppled, crushing Taboo. The battle between the two supernatural combatants eventually toppled Taboo's entire headquarters down onto the two combatants. Algon was killed in the ensuing destruction, the consciousnesses of Phillip and Topaz returned to their true bodies. The Werewolf somehow survived the destruction.
powers: (formerly): He also briefly possessed the power to turn anything he touched into gold.
weaknesses: Algon's body required another person's mind in order to possess sentience. Even then, he possessed little ability for thought himself, almost entirely carrying out the orders of his father.

ali hamud.name: Ali Hamud
ali hamud.origin: Ali Hamud was a Arabian Prince who fled to the Belgian Congo and set up a home there to keep away from his enemies. With the outbreak of World War II, Ali allied himself with the Nazis, building a runway on his property to allow German planes to refuel before moving on to attacking Britain's African colonies. His brother Saba silently opposed this alliance, biding his time for the right time to strike. When the jungle hero Ka-Zar, in a stolen Nazi plane, spotted a Nazi banner flying on Hamud's property, he landed his plane to investigate. Ali mistook Ka-Zar for Nazi Captain Olendorff and explained the entire operation to Ka-Zar before the real Olendorff arrived. Realizing he had been tricked, Ali had Ka-Zar taken prisoner and tossed into a torture pit where the hero had to fight off warriors and a leopard. Ka-Zar was rescued from the pit by Saba. Shown how to escape by Saba, who planned to blow up the entire estate, Ka-Zar fled. In his escape attempt he clashed once more with Ali Hamud and Captain Olendorff. During the fight Ka-Zar tossed a burning torch onto Ali Hamud, burning him alive while fleeing the scene in a Nazi bomber just moments before Saba detonated his explosives destroying the castle and all the Nazis inside.
weaknesses: Ali Hamud would leave fighting to his subordinates, leaving him vulnerable should they fail to stop an attacker.

ali hassan.name: Ali Hassan
ali hassan.origin: Ali Hassan was the leader of an army of thieves who roamed the Algerian desert during the 1940's. He and his men became so troublesome for travelling caravans the Foreign Legion sent in their men to set up an outpost to stop the thieves. Hassan and his men made two failed attempts to slaughter the Legion members thanks to the efforts of Soldier of Fortune Captain Robert Strong who had his men decimate Hassan's minions and capture Hassan himself, turning him over to the authorities.

Despite the lycanthropic nature of their daughter Kahlima, Maksoud allowed her to live free, while concealing from others what she truly was. After she was eventually captured by Sheik Abdul Zu Fadh and publicly revealed her true nature, Ali Maksoud was forced to kill her.

ali ben ar.name: Ali-Ben Ar
ali ben ar.origin: The eldest son of Caliph Abu-Ben Ar, Ali-Ben Ar was believed to be the one chosen by Allah himself to unite the peoples of Islam and lead them to their destiny. He strongly opposed slavery, and released the prisoners taken to his father by a Portuguese pirate, among whom there was Solomon Kane. Wishing to say a prayer to Allah in the mosque before his ultimate journey to the Mountain of Sighs, he there found his dying father, who told him he had been murdered by the Portuguese cutthroats and Solomon Kane. He then confronted and fought the puritan, but changed his mind when Kane saved him from the poisonous bite of the asps lurking in the sacred tomb. Desiring not to be the Prophet anymore, he returned to the royal palace, only to find his beloved Shareen dead by self-induced poisoning.

aliana alba.name: Aliana Alba
aliana alba.first_appearance: Weapons of Mutant Destruction: Alpha Vol 1 1
aliana alba.origin: Dr. Aliana Alba was the chief scientist working on Weapon X's Vat H sector, which consisted on the implementation of the Hulk's genetic material in the organization's Adamantium cyborgs. Dr. Alba's research progressed, though with numerous failed attempts in the process. Her two most successful attempts were the test subjects H-Alpha and H-Beta, the latter being Bobby Andrews. When the Weapon X Central Command was attacked by the Hulk and his allies, Dr. Alba disobeyed Director Stryker's orders to evacuate, being unwilling to let loose the final two test subjects before their incubation period ended. After buying time by releasing her failed test subjects to attack the Hulk's allies, Dr. Alba observed as H-Beta broke free from containment, ready to attack Weapon X's enemies. While Hulk and H-Beta were fighting, Dr. Alba unleashed the final subject, H-Alpha. After killing H-Beta, H-Alpha proved resistant to Dr. Alba's attempts to remotely control him with an implant, with only the Hulk managing to hold him back from turning on his creators. As the Hulk and H-Alpha continued fighting, Dr. Alba and Stryker made their escape. After the Weapon X Project caught up to H-Alpha, Dr. Alba injected him with a nanite strain capable of resetting his command settings, and then commanded him to attack Stryker and his cyborgs. When Weapon H was commanded by Dr. Alba to kill the entire population of Phoenix, Arizona to prove his perfection, the same group of mutants who raided the Weapon X central command along with the Hulk, whom Weapon H had previously encountered and easily defeated, and Wolverine broke him free from Dr. Alba's control. Dr. Alba was subsequently apprehended and placed in custody at the X-Club headquarters in Costa Rica. Alba somehow regained her freedom and was manipulated by Roxxon CEO Dario Agger into following the trail of the original Wolverine, Logan, who was in turn tracking down Weapon H due to Agger's machinations. Alba crossed paths with the Leader, who had been similarly lured into the trail of Weapon H through the Hulk. Sterns and Alba initially attempted to kill each other, until they realized they were being puppeteered and decided to join forces. After taking over Shadow Base's remote facility FN34, the two scientists abducted the Hulk and Logan and gave both each other's powers. The two Hulkverines were then dropped off at another Shadow Base facility to meet its automated defensive system as a test of power. In a state of bloodshot rage, they started fighting each other until Weapon H intercepted the fight and lured them to Alba and the Leader's observation post. Weapon H also disarmed the Leader of his teleporter, forcing Dr. Alba to stop the Hulk and Logan by recalling the nanobot swarm she had infected them with, undoing their mutation. She turned the nanobots on Weapon H in an attempt to erase his memories, but the plan failed. With the Leader having finished repairing his teleporter, both he and Alba fled. Throughout their team-up, Alba and the Leader had grown closer together due to their reciprocal admiration of each other's intelligence, and kissed afterward. Allying herself with the Abomination, Dr. Alba worked for the insurrectionist group Project Green Spring. Alba used slivers of Blonsky's skin to make grafts that turned test subjects into gamma-mutated monsters. Green Spring's efforts also included the distribution of low-level gamma grafts to the population of Thomasville, Texas, which were marketed as a supplement called Fortify. One of Green Spring's test subjects was Sergeant Dionne Fortean. She ran away when she learned of Green Spring's experimentation with the townspeople, and crossed paths with the gamma-focused task force Gamma Flight. Joining the team, Dionne helped raid Thomasville, where Gamma Flight hijacked Green Spring's Cathexis Ray to reverse the effects of Fortify on the townspeople. When the Abomination and Dr. Alba confronted Gamma Flight, Dr. Alba cornered Gamma Flight's member, Dr. Charlene McGowan, and prepared to kill her with a laser gun. Using her translocator technology, McGowan opened a portal in front of herself, which teleported Alba's shot to hit her in her own back, seemingly killing her.

alice hoffman.name: Alice Hoffman
alice hoffman.origin: Alice Hoffman was a famous actress but also an extremist from the Humans Off Planet environmentalist group. She was the contact between HOP and General Urt for the supply of weapons intended to blow up the pipeline in Alaska, but the Punisher pretended to be a man from Urt and made contact with Alice pretending that he would provide her with the necessary weapons meeting in a predetermined place, but in fact she set a trap for him that the Punisher managed to escape anyway. Convinced that General Urt would support the idea of ​​nature conservation HOP in Alaska, she went to meet the General at his home along with John Three Poles, a native member of HOP, and when John pronounced that the ecological group did not he wanted further relations with the General and his methods of destruction for the acquisition of power, the General killed him with his own bare hands. Alice opened her eyes to the General's true nature, then fled the General's abode and ran to the Punisher telling him that she wanted to help him oppose the General's aims. He accompanied the Punisher to the geothermal station and there with a sniper shot she killed the General's assistant. Alice flew her plane accompanying the Punisher to Kamchatka to put an end to the matter of General Urt. There they helped a group of local freedom fighters to oppose General Urt and there she had a love affair with Frank. Eventually they blew up the refinery by launching missiles at the fuel tanks and killing General Urt.

alice hu.name: Alice Hu
alice hu.origin: Alice Hu was a Canadian reporter who reported on the attack by Nerkkod on Vancouver. When the helicopter she was in was struck by the Hammer of Nerkkod, Alpha Flight's Guardian saved her. She then proceeded to question him about his family's legal troubles over their daughter but was disrupted by his wife, Vindicator. Hu was later abducted by Department H forces as part of a sweep by the government to remove all "dissidents" who would oppose the rule of Prime Minister Gary Cody and his Unity Party. She, along with many others, was transported to Saskatchewan where she was forced into labor mining natural resources using Groundhog Armor. Alpha Flight later liberated the labor camp and the members of the burgeoning resistance fled. thumb|left Alpha Flight recruited the Taskmaster to train the resistance members, resulting in Hu's surprise attack against Guardian, knocking him "out." Hu was part of the forces that brought about the destruction of the Master's ship and the end of the Unity Party.
powers: None.

alice joyce maxfield.name: Alice Joyce Maxfield
alice joyce maxfield.origin: Alice Joyce "A.J." Maxfield was a medical research scientist who found herself sought out by both Spider-Man and Count Dracula. The hero needed her for a vaccine he believed could help treat his aunt, May Parker, while the vampire lord wished to kill her and destroy her research so they would not someday threaten vaguely defined plans of his. Mistakenly believing A.J. Maxfield to be a man, Dracula slew an innocent at a costume party on board an ocean liner while Spider-Man dealt with a gang of criminals also looking for the doctor. Fortunately, Dr. Maxfield was a woman in a Valkyrie costume whom the count had briefly considered feeding upon, leaving her alive and well, and able to supply Spider-Man with the necessary medicine.

alice michaels.name: Alice Michaels
alice michaels.species: Human who was somehow transformed in a bug-monster queen. After being killed by Nico, she suffered another metamorphosis and gained her current appearance.
alice michaels.origin: Alice woke up one day, having acquired an insect form. She tried to hide it, but, unintentionally infected someone, which unleashed a plague of insect-like people. Meanwhile, A-Force was recovering from Thanos's attack, when they received information from the Inhuman precog Ulysses that Nico would kill someone named Alice. To avoid being arrested, Nico teleported herself to a safe house in Ouray, only to find the city completely crowded with insect-like people. thumb|left|230px Elsa Bloodstone then appeared and presented Nico to Janine, who happened to be Alice's mother. In that moment, the rest of A-Force appeared. After a brief discussion, they agreed Nico should not be arrested, so they split the team in two, with half going to an abandoned mine to search for Alice. There, they found out that Alice was responsible for everything that was happening and that the only way to revert everything back to normal was for Nico to kill Alice. After Elsa was infected, and everyone on the team (except Nico and Singularity) ended up contracting the disease, she trapped them in a time bubble and tried to revert Alice to her human appearance. Seeing this didn't solve the problem, Nico was forced to kill Alice, however, as the team regrouped, Alice was shown to have suffered another transformation and to be safe and sound. She then simply vanished.
