alvise gianus.name: Alvise Gianus
alvise gianus.first_appearance: Spider-Man: The Secret of Glass Vol 1 1
alvise gianus.origin: Count Alvise Gianus was a 16th or 17th-Century Italian nobleman, skilled scientist and alchemist. member of the noble house know as Casata del Ragno (House of Spider). Dedicating his life to alchemical glass making, he crossed the line of the dark arts using human blood to obtain more beautiful artifacts. Once exposed as a gruesome killer, the Venice Doge dispatched the Sicari della Notte (an assassins guild, encharged to preserve the secrets of the Venetian glass making) to get rid of him. Thrown in a pot full of molten alchemical glass, disfigured by the heat, Count Alvise rests for centuries in the San Michele Island cemetery in Venice, while his powers were growing, fed by the same unbreakable glass cage. In modern days, Gianus has been freed from his captivity by the touch of Peter Parker. It turns out that the two are tied, being Count Gianus from the ancient "Casata del Ragno. Strong and unstoppable, the deranged nobleman went on a rampage during the city carnival, vitrifying the bystanders. After a first fight that saw Count Alvise victorious, Spider-Man attacked him in his laboratory and managed to trap him again in a glass cocoon, putting him back in the House of Spider's crypt.
powers: Low level telepathy, .
weapons: Count Gianus carries a staff whose handle - modeled in the shape of a spider - emits a vitrification ray. Also, the staff reacts to the wielder, discharging stunning energy of unknown nature if used against his owner.

alyssa bryon.name: Alyssa Bryon
alyssa bryon.first_appearance: All-Winners Squad: Band of Heroes Vol 1 1
alyssa bryon.origin: Alyssa Bryon is a famous novelist and the granddaughter of William Bryon, who was secretly the Young Avenger during World War II. She spends much of her time looking after her elderly grandfather who was now 92 years old and has a bad leg, requiring him to use a cane to walk. Each year she accompanies her grandfather to the grave of Piotr, a man she believed to be a cousin of the family who died a hero during the Second World War. Alyssa's grandfather had told his entire family that he himself hadn't been able to enlist in the war because of his leg, but this was a lie. He tells Alyssa that it's about time that he tells his story and asks her if she would be willing to tell it exactly as he says. When Alyssa agrees, William shows her a storeroom of vintage war era comics that he has held on to since the 1940s and tells Alyssa that before he relates his story to her, she must read all of these books. Despite believing them to be the worst thing that she's ever read, she humours her grandfather by staying up all night reading them all. In the morning her grandfather reveals to her that these stories were all based on real men, soldiers who were brought together in a unit known as the Crazy S.U.E.S. and that the comics were meant to increase support for the war, including enlistment rates. Finally, William reveals to his granddaughter that he had never been rejected for military service and was, in fact, the Young Avenger. Alyssa sits her grandfather down to record him while he tells his story. He reveals the origins of the Crazy SUES and tells her about a man named Captain Flame. Alyssa admits that she has looked online for mention of Captain Flame and/or the comic book he appeared in, but could find absolutely nothing. William reveals that his is the only surviving copy as the publisher had the rest destroyed following Captain Flame's death. He tells her that Captain Flame was part of the biggest secret in World War II, one of the most significant secrets in America's history. This is reinterrated to Alyssa when they take a break and someone claiming to be a friend hacks into her computer and reveals the name Operation Firefly to her. When she asks her grandfather what Operation Firefly was however, Bryon keels over with what looks like a heart attack. Alyssa tries to call 911, but is confronted by Loki, the Norse god of mischief. Loki tells Alyssa that he knows someone has contacted her about Operation Firefly and states that the project contains sensitive information which he would prefer be kept secret. Alyssa was afraid that Loki had done something to her grandfather, but Loki states that his current condition was a result of too much fast food over the years. He tells Alyssa to inform the mysterious stranger that he is looking for him if they should speak again and disappears. Alyssa then summons an ambulance for William and accompanies him to the hospital. Despite not leaving his bedside, her grandfather never wakes up. His funeral consists of a small service with Alyssa and a few of the Young Avenger's surviving war comrades as the only mourners. One of these mourners is Steven Rogers, better known as Captain America. Alyssa relates to him how she was in the process of writing her grandfather's memoirs when he passed away and the Captain agrees to help her out in any way he can. When asked about Operation Firefly, however, Rogers informs her that he never heard of that particular operation as his time with the Crazy SUES had been brief. Alyssa then noticed another wartime comrade of her late grandfather, Slow-Motion Jones. Despite his reliance on a walker for mobility, Slow-Motion was still able to disappear before Alyssa could catch up to him to ask him some questions. Driving home after the funeral, Alyssa is again contacted by her mysterious "friend" who somehow patched through her car radio in order to communicate with her. He warns her that there are men in an unmarked car following her and reveals that the Young Avenger had once saved his life. He encourages Alyssa to get to the bottom of the mystery that is Operation Firefly, providing her with the home address of Slow-Motion so that she may continue her investigation. Despite some second guessing, Alyssa goes to the address given to her. After much pleading, she convinces a very reluctant Slow-Motion to talk to her about the events experienced by the Crazy SUES during the war, claiming that he had been the one who killed Captain Flame. When asked about Operation Firefly, Slow-Motion reveals that the surviving Crazy SUES had been forced to sign a contract forbidding them to speak of what they had seen. He fears for the safety of his daughters if he says too much, but continues to speak to Alyssa, telling her that Frank Cortez practically was Operation Firefly, but that he just couldn't handle the horrors of war. alzzan.name: Alzzan
alzzan.origin: Alzzan was a General in the Krozzar Empire. His species controlled an area of Earth in the 21st-century of Earth-691, with most of the planet in hands of the Martian Masters. Along with some 75 other Krozzars, including fifty warriors, Alzzan was captured by a time storm that catapulted them to 1871's Dodge City. They soon constructed a military base in a circular perimeter while trying to find an explanation for their unwanted trip. The scientists could not provide an answer to the situation, in part because they were harassed by the locals (three other time-travelling armies were competing for the resources). The Krozzar began capturing and enslaving locals to be used as indoctrinated slave recruits, but they still needed a full military control of the area. Alzzan provided the slave troops with weapons, food, clothes and training, as well as constriction collars for the most dangerous ones. Under General Alzzan, they organized a military campaign using their only beta-bomb to cause a geo-thermal chain reaction, destroying every life form in twenty miles (Some 400,000 humans). To do so, they needed to assault one of the displaced armies, the Hellenics (led by Alexander the Great), to obtain an access route to a certain mountain. Although this operation was important to the Krozzar, the Krozzar leader provided important resources to a native ally, Doctor Doom, who seemed able to solve their problem. However, Alexander the Great had discovered the Krozzar scheme and allied with other generals, Napoléon Bonaparte and Genghis Khan. Their combined might and tactical prowess was clearly superior to Alzzan. When he tried capture a route for the bomb, the Krozzar army found three well-prepared armies led by the best military minds on Earth, instead of unsuspecting barbarians. The humans fought for fifteen hours before retreating to regroup. The Krozzar still harassed them, but could make no progress. Even worse, some time-travelling heroes had reached the unprotected Krozzar base and defused the beta-bomb, laying waste the Krozzar scheme. They eventually solved the time crisis and sent all the Krozzars back to their time. It is unclear if Alzzan was alive at that time, or if he had died in the battle.

fields.place_of_birth: Somewhere in the Krozzar Empire, in 20th or 21th century, Earth-619
fields.history: Alzzan was a General in the Krozzar Empire. His species controlled an area of Earth in the 21st-century of Earth-691, with most of the planet in hands of the Martian Masters. Along with some 75 other Krozzars, including fifty warriors, Alzzan was captured by a time storm that catapulted them to 1871's Dodge City. They soon constructed a military base in a circular perimeter while trying to find an explanation for their unwanted trip. The scientists could not provide an answer to the situation, in part because they were harassed by the locals (three other time-travelling armies were competing for the resources). The Krozzar began capturing and enslaving locals to be used as indoctrinated slave recruits, but they still needed a full military control of the area. Alzzan provided the slave troops with weapons, food, clothes and training, as well as constriction collars for the most dangerous ones. Under General Alzzan, they organized a military campaign using their only beta-bomb to cause a geo-thermal chain reaction, destroying every life form in twenty miles (Some 400,000 humans). To do so, they needed to assault one of the displaced armies, the Hellenics (led by Alexander the Great), to obtain an access route to a certain mountain. Although this operation was important to the Krozzar, the Krozzar leader provided important resources to a native ally, Doctor Doom, who seemed able to solve their problem. However, Alexander the Great had discovered the Krozzar scheme and allied with other generals, Napoléon Bonaparte and Genghis Khan. Their combined might and tactical prowess was clearly superior to Alzzan. When he tried capture a route for the bomb, the Krozzar army found three well-prepared armies led by the best military minds on Earth, instead of unsuspecting barbarians. The humans fought for fifteen hours before retreating to regroup. The Krozzar still harassed them, but could make no progress. Even worse, some time-travelling heroes had reached the unprotected Krozzar base and defused the beta-bomb, laying waste the Krozzar scheme. They eventually solved the time crisis and sent all the Krozzars back to their time. It is unclear if Alzzan was alive at that time, or if he had died in the battle.

am.name: Am
am.origin: Am, the Monster with a Soul, was a creation of serial writer Allan Slake who worked for WMGP. One day in 1946 he was told by the program director to come up with an idea for a horror serial that was even greater than Frankenstein's Monster but was also believable. Slake's creation was Am, the Monster with a Soul, and it became the station's most popular serial, earning national broadcasts and captivating audiences across the United States. By some freak of nature, the collective fear and belief of the American public caused Am to materialize in the real world during one of the serial broadcasts. Am went on a rampage in the town where WMGP was located, killing any who got in his way. Hearing this one the radio, the new Captain America and Bucky went into action to stop the creature's rampage. Hearing the reports himself, Slake did not want his creation to be destroyed and soon discovered that writing on his typewriter effected reality so far as the actions of Am were concerned. With his "telepathic typewriter" Slake commanded Am to defeat Captain America and Bucky and then return to his home. After making Am his slave, Slake sent the creature to kill a scientist who lived in a local observatory to allow Slake to take control of it and watch Am as he sent the creature on more rampages. When Captain America and Bucky interfered once more, Am knocked them out and brought Captain America back to his hideout under Allan's orders. Bucky followed the creature and freed Cap and the two heroes battled Am once more. The creature, becoming more hideous and powerful by the public's fear, easily defeated Cap and Bucky and then killed Slake. Am took the telepathic typewriter for himself, determined never to be controlled by anybody ever again. Retreating, Am captured Daily Globe reporter Dorothy Roberts and secreted away to a nearby cave where he also hid the typewriter so that nobody else could control him. Dorothy managed to convince Am that the only way to stop himself from becoming more hideous was to do good deeds to change public opinion of him. Dorothy suggested that Am to bring local mobster Jigger Jones to justice. Am crashed Jigger's hideout and despite being opposed by Captain America and Bucky again he managed to escape with Jigger as his prisoner. Bringing Jigger back to his cave, Am demanded to know why he was still ugly. Jigger took advantage of the situation, convincing Am that the only way that Dorothy would ever love him was if he brought her jewels and money. Each cloudy night, Am accompanied Jigger and his mob in their zeppelin to rob local banks and jewel shops. Growing frustrated with the fact he was becoming even more ugly, Am eventually snapped and slew Jigger and his gang just as Captain America and Bucky tracked the creature back to his hideout. Freeing Dorothy, they clashed with the monster once more telling Dorothy to find the typewriter and use it to kill the monster. Dorothy was reluctant to do so until the creature was posed to strike a killing blow on Captain America. Typing the words "Am Dies!" into the type writer caused Am to suddenly drop dead, falling down a pit. Captain America then tossed the type writer down with Am. As they left the cave they all agreed that the tortured monster indeed had a soul.
powers: Am had super-human strength that seemed to increase proportionately based on the collective fear of all those who believed that he really existed. This collective fear also caused Am to become more and more hideous as well.
aliases: Am, the Monster with a Soul

amalric the aquilonian.name: Amalric the Aquilonian
amalric the aquilonian.origin: Amalric the Aquilonian was, along with Conan, part of a mercenary army that invaded Stygia and was ultimately decimated as a result of treachery. Amalric become separated from Conan, but the latter spied him, days later, with a beautiful girl named Lissa being chased across the night desert by seven fiery-eyed, skull-faced horsemen. However, the monsters vanished as soon as conan rushed to his friend's aid. Amalric took Lissa back to her birthplace, Gazal, only to then save her from Ollam-Onga, the demon of the red tower. He was later pursued once more by the skull-riders, however, he safely reached Tombalku, where he slew a local wizard named Askia. Afterward, Almaric and Conan encountered an approaching caravan outside the city gates, they followed the traders to bypass Tombalku's civil war, and joined their group.

amalya.name: Amalya
amalya.origin: Originally a princess from an unnamed planet, Amalya was kidnapped and held captive by a gang of criminals until she was rescued by Rocket Raccoon. She instantly fell in love with him, and the two had a brief relationship before Rocket left her and pilfered a small fortune from her family. Cast out for dishonoring the reputation of her house, and heartbroken by rejection, the now "General" Amalya assembled a team of Rocket's ex-girlfriends from across the galaxy to make him pay at any cost.

aman sinaya.name: Aman Sinaya
aman sinaya.species: One of the three primary Diwata
aman sinaya.origin: Aman Sinaya was one of the three primary Diwata sired by Gaea, along with Bathala and Amihan, and was the goddess of the sea. Together, the three gods fashioned the first mortals from a bamboo shoot, instilling them with a soul (or "kaluluwa"). The belief in the Diwatas started from approximately 4000 BC. In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Aman Sinaya for the Diwatas. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened. The worship of the Diwatas lasted until the 16 century AD. left|thumb|Aman Sinaya, Zuras, & Aswang attend the Council of Godheads In modern times, Aman Sinaya (alongside Zuras of the Eternals and Aswang of the Diwatas) gathered amongst other gods in an undisclosed extradimensional realm to witness the Council of Godheads judge the worthiness of Phobos to become the next Olympian god of fear.
weapons: Aman Sinaya wields a sibat (a Filipino long spear dating back to the ancient times) and a taming (a traditional Filipino round rattan shield).

amanda armstrong.name: Amanda Armstrong
amanda armstrong.origin: Amanda Armstrong's father was a secret federal agent killed in the line of duty by A.I.M., though the public and Amanda were led to believe he had been murdered by a drug cartel. As a young adult, Amanda became a small-time musician under the stage name of Amanda Strong. One night after a performance, she was recruited into S.H.I.E.L.D. by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, hoping to use her career as a cover for missions around the world. With the help of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s contacts, Amanda became a moderately successful vocalist for her own band. One night before travelling to Germany to deliver a package, she met the package's courier, a fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent named Jude. When she arrived to the Indra Club in Hamburg, Amanda's cover was blown, and she was attacked by an assassin. Jude saved her life, later admitting that he had followed her to Germany hoping to see her performance and ask her on a date afterwards. The two agents were soon intercepted by undercover Hydra soldiers, but managed to escape from the hotel where Jude had taken Amanda regardless of the enemy presence. thumb|left|Young Amanda The incident at the Indra Club was covered up as an attack from an overzealous fan, allowing Amanda to remain operating undercover. She continued her career, and started dating Jude. After a two-year relationship, Amanda became pregnant and quit S.H.I.E.L.D.. A week before the baby was due, Jude tried to convince Amanda to disappear. He eventually revealed to have been working as a Hydra double-agent, showing his true nature as a selfish man who had no problem working for both sides and selling out fellow agents as long as it made profit. As Jude was trying to convince Amanda to accept Hydra's protection, she stabbed him in the neck with a pair of scissors. Shocked by this development, Amanda decided she was going to give up the baby for adoption to a happy and safe family, requesting wherever he was sent to, the baby retained his birth name: Anthony. S.H.I.E.L.D. partially granted Amanda her wish, and instead left the baby in an orphanage in Sofia, Bulgaria, the place where it was born. After learning of Amanda's pregnancy, S.H.I.E.L.D. founder Howard Stark kept an eye on the baby and adopted him, taking the birth records in the process. thumb|right|Reunited with her son Decades later, Amanda had become a London-based music producer. When Tony Stark investigated his true parentage, he found that Amanda could've been his true mother, and visited her at her record label. Tony demonstrated his desire to get to know his mother, and the two hugged as Amanda called him, "My boy." Before Amanda could bond with her son, Tony fell into a coma as a consequence of the second superhuman civil war. Tony's company, Stark Industries, fell to the hands of Amanda as established by his will. Amanda accepted the position to prevent the board of directors from taking control of the company, while Tony's A.I. assistant Friday ran the company behind the curtains. When Tony recovered from his injuries, he went into hiding for a brief time. After he meet up with Amanda to ensure her he was safe, she was approached by Jude. He revealed her he had been resurrected by Hydra, and continued operating from behind the scenes for decades, only deciding to step into the light after learning what had become of their son. Jude coerced her into luring Tony to a trap. However, Tony's assistant Mary Jane Watson appeared and shot Jude in the shoulder, which prompted him to decloak a battalion of Hydra soldiers. A massive fight sparked after Ironheart and many other heroes arrived to confront Hydra. In the middle of the brawl, Jude got hold of MJ's gun and tried to shoot Amanda in the back. Before he could to so, he was knocked out by Iron Man. Amanda joined the upper management of her son's subsequent enterprise, the think tank called Stark Unlimited. She hit it off with roboticist Andy Bhang, a music aficionado and a fan of hers, and eventually got into a relationship with him. On the other hand, Amanda found it hard to connect with her son, and struggled to find common ground with him since Tony was constantly occupied; something Amanda worried Tony was doing on purpose to avoid her. thumb|250px|left|Amanda being confronted by Motherboard inside the eScape When Tony launched his next major project, a virtual landscape called the eScape, Amanda followed him into the digital world, but she was abducted by the eScape's operating system, Motherboard, who had been unwittingly damaged and left corrupted by a hacker attack from the villainous Controller. Motherboard was a program made from the engrams of Tony's late adoptive mother Maria Stark, and she contended that she was Tony's true mother. To this end, Motherboard used her ability to warp eScape to her whim to enthrall Tony. At the end of the five years, and in the day she was run over, she killed her husband thinking she would get away with it as she was paralyzed and the murder had been committed on the first floor of their apartment, she would be exonerated, but intuition and the investigative skills of Louise Mason, aka Blonde Phantom, uncovered the deception and Amanda was captured and arrested on murder charges.

amanda mueller.name: Amanda Müeller
amanda mueller.origin: ===Origins=== thumb|left|Amanda Müeller Amanda Müeller was born in the 19th-century to a presumably wealthy background. She possessed an early example of mutant genes, making her a ripe commodity for the immortal geneticist Dr. Nathaniel Essex. Calling himself Milbury, Essex entered into an arrangement with Müeller where she married a man and became pregnant, then feigned miscarriages so that Essex could take these mutant infants and study their genetic material. It seems Müeller was well compensated for her efforts. In 1891, after surviving a series of miscarriages, Amanda Müeller came under suspicion and was accused of being the Black Womb killer. Milbury testified on her behalf, and she was ultimately found not guilty at trial, although her genuine innocence was still in question. Müeller was married to Daniel Summers, who left Amanda with their only son because he couldn't handle the accusations. ===Black Womb Project=== Because of her mutation, Amanda was extremely long lived. Decades ago, she was part of government research project that was gaining research on mutants. Other members included Kurt Marko (father of the Juggernaut and stepfather of Charles Xavier) and Irene Adler (lover of Mystique). Amanda must have had a slowed aging factor as she gave birth to a woman called Fontanelle who was in her early fifties in the early twentieth century. thumb|left Amanda headed the Black Womb Project in her later years. In one video she smothered a mutant child for her research. Amanda retained her mutant powers after M-Day. After Mr. Sinister was nearly killed in Messiah Complex, he tried to slip into the mind of Professor X or Sebastian Shaw using his Cronus device. Amanda was aware of Sinister's plan, and vowed to kill Professor X and Shaw so she could steal Sinister's power for herself. While Professor X beat Sinister mentally and Gambit charged up Shaw to destroy the Cronus device, Amanda saw her chance to escape in the ensuing chaos. ===Fall of X=== Amidst the fall of Krakoa, Müeller became the secret head of Parvenu Industries, aiming to complete her life's work of creating the Neocracy. A clone of Müeller once revealed this goal to Sinister. During the confrontation between her and Cable, her nutrient tanks got dealt a damaging blow that resulted in her dying slowly. When agents from Parvenu Industries were harvesting her corpse, it was said that her body had become like liquid.
powers: Amanda was immortal, but not immune to the non-lethal effects of aging, including increasingly wrinkled skin and immobility.

amanda saint.name: Amanda Saint
amanda saint.origin: Amanda Saint's mother left her when her father discovered she had been involved with the satanic cult, Demon-Fire. Her father soon left, searching for his wife. Amanda stayed at home with her older sister Catherine, and dated a guy named Justin. Unbeknownst to Amanda, both her sister and her boyfriend were also members of Demon-Fire, who sought to use her as a virgin sacrifice. Amanda was rescued from their first attempt at capture by the living vampire Morbius, who originally had planned on using her as a victim himself. Upon returning home, she was quickly captured and was to be sacrificed to the spider-demon Arachne. Morbius saved her again, and most of the members of the San Francisco sect, including her sister, were killed and their temple destroyed. In search of her mother, Amanda and Morbius traveled to Malevolence, Maine, where they stayed in the boarding house of a Mrs. Agnes, who was actually Sister Saint in disguise. Blood-Tide, leader of the Malevolence sect, directed Sister Saint to kill the two, but Morbius saved her again, eventually slaying Blood-Tide. Sister Saint fell on her own axe and split her head open. Morbius left out the details, but told her that he learned that her mother was dead. In search of her father, Amanda and Morbius arrived at the amusement park in Gallow's Bend, Nevada. There they found her father, recently hanged by other members of Demon-Fire. They were attacked by Reaper, Death-Flame, Rigor, Phineas T. Coroner, and eventually the leader of the whole cult, Apocalypse. In the course of the battle, Amanda allowed Morbius to drink some of her blood to regain his strength to battle the cult. Ultimately, Howie Rivers , owner of the amusement park, decided to sacrifice his park to stop the demons. He and Sagebrush Robbins, either an employee or a local defending the area from demons, wired the park with dynamite and blew it up, killing Apocalypse and every other cult member present. What became of Amanda after this is unknown.

amanda sheridan.name: Amanda Sheridan
amanda sheridan.origin: Amanda's mother was born a slave, and her father was hung by the Ku Klux Klan. Amanda married Jacob Sheridan and stayed with him during the harsh winters of Alaska as he worked as a gold miner, starting the family fortune from scratch. At one point, Amanda may have had acrophobia. However, during one of these Alaskans cold times, a Kodiak bear harassed Jacob and Amanda, prompting them to climb a tree quickly; then the bear refused to leave, Amanda theorizing that they were the only available food, so the Sheridans were forced to kill it. Ever from that moment, Amanda lost her fear. After giving Amanda several children, Jacob died. Amanda then created and headed Sheridan Industries, a company with offices in a penthouse in Santa Ana, California. She was also honored with the treatment "Lady". Lady Amanda lived in Beverly Hills, owning a second residence in the mid-nineties of the Fifth Avenue in New York City, and employing a personal butler. She became reputed as the richest woman in the world at one time, but she claimed to only have gone the extra mile for her family, which included several adult grandchildren such as Thomas and Samantha ("Sam"), a geophysicist. The amoral weapon manufacturing concern Deterrence Research Corporation, led by ruthless CEO Moses Magnum, was hired to develop a toxic biochemical gas to be used as a weapon, and Magnum arranged for it to be tested on kidnapped innocents in an undisclosed death camp in the jungles South America. Their victims included Lady Amanda's grandson Thomas Sheridan and his family, as well as Samantha's parents, brother and baby sister, all of them dead in the swamps in unmarked graves. Lady Amanda eventually discovered about the specific gruesome effect of the gas and the pain suffered by her relatives. The Punisher and Spider-Man eventually found about the operation and stopped it, and the Punisher was believed to have killed Magnum himself (thou Magnum secretly survived and escaped), but by then the kidnapped Sheridans were already dead, even if other prisoners were released. The Deterrence Research Corporation deflected any and all responsibility for the disaster, and continued with their activities, much to Lady Amanda and Samantha Sheridan's disappointment. Lady Amanda openly craved revenge for her family, leading to conflict between Sheridan Industries and the DRC. Approximately at this point, young Eric Lazar joined the board of Sheridan Industries and earned a reputation of being trustworthy for the following six years; but at some point the DRC secretly hired Lazar so he'd work for them, infiltrated in Sheridan Industries. Lady Amanda discovered that Magnum was alive, and "working on a project of literally earth-shaking magnitude" (which was correct, Magnum was developing a machine to cause earthquakes from the area of Japan), which was likely to put her granddaughter in danger (which was again correct, as Samantha was an expert in the faults, having already detected the effects caused by Magnum's tests, and Magnum intended to abduct her to question her on the specific effects of his technology). Lady Amanda would have gone after Magnum herself if she had been young and strong enough but, as she was not, she tried to find and hire the Punisher to track and kill Magnum, only to find the Punisher "unavailable". She then sent several "normal" agents after Magnum, only for them to disappear. She then summoned superpowered hero for hire Power Man to her New York home, and offered to hire Power Man to kill Magnum - but Power Man refused. She did hire Power Man to protect Samantha against Magnum's forces, both understanding that the task may or may not require lethal force against Magnum to be fulfilled. Lady Amanda provided Power Man with a passport and a plane ticket to go to Tokyo, Japan, to meet with Samantha, who was there researching Magnum's artificial earthquakes. As predicted by Lady Amanda, Magnum did kidnap Samantha, only for her to be rescued by Power Man and for Magnum's island base to be destroyed, with him inside; secretly, however, Magnum survive again. Later, Lady Amanda and Samantha moved together to Santa Ana, California, where Samantha began helping her great-grandmother (whom she nicknamed "Gram") managing the company. Knowing that Lady Amanda had sworn to get even with the DRC, the DRC reacted by starting a corporate takeover of Sheridan Industries, so that Lady Amanda would not have resources to oppose them. The DRC decided to kidnap Lady Amanda so that she'd miss a critical board meeting where her presence was required to control the rest of Sheridan Industries board members. DRC used sent of their superhuman employees, Hammer and Anvil, to kidnap Lady Amanda in the night; however, criminologist Scotty McDowell discovered part of their plan and sent his superheroine friend Spider-Woman to patrol a certain area. During the night, Hammer and Anvil ambushed the Sheridans' Rolls-Royce, at that point driven by Samantha and with Lady A

fields.notes: When retelling the story of Power Man Annual #1, both and (Moses Magnum's profiles) mistakenly say that Power Man rescued Amanda Sheridan, hired by her grandmother. In the story, he rescues Samantha Sheridan, not Amanda, and was hired by Samantha's great-grandmother Amanda. In Power Man Annual #1, Amanda says that his grandson Thomas and his family were killed by Moses Magnum. In Spider-Woman #34, Amanda's great-granddaughter Samantha says that her parents and siblings were killed by Moses Magnum. This may be interpreted as Thomas being Samantha's father - but in that case, Amanda's sentence would be misleading, "My grandson's family, Cage -- murdered by Moses Magnum", as not all of his family had been murdered. This article thus assumes that Thomas is not Samantha's father, and that Moses killed both Thomas and Samantha's father (who was also Thomas' brother).

amanda von doom.name: Amanda von Doom
amanda von doom.origin: Amanda von Doom was the commander of the Mad Squad, a government team specializing in the elimination of dangerous scientists who had become a threat. Despite her surname, she clarified that she had no family connection to Doctor Doom. Her early life began under tragic circumstances, as her mother died in childbirth, and Amanda was born into a world associated with one of Latveria's harshest prisons. Amanda first sought the Hulk's cooperation after discovering that Bruce Banner had become dangerously unstable while attempting to recreate the accident that had originally transformed him. Banner's experiments had produced an island populated by gamma-mutated animals, and his theft of gamma materials from a military installation convinced Amanda that he had to be stopped. Although the Hulk initially refused to get involved, he eventually agreed to help, insisting that Banner would be his to deal with. Amanda and the Mad Squad subsequently confronted the scientist on his island, where they encountered his monstrous creations and discovered that he had prepared a gamma bomb. When the bomb detonated, Banner was killed, and Amanda later witnessed the Hulk mourning the remains of his former alter ego alongside the surviving creatures. She and her team were then forced to negotiate with the gamma-mutates, who demanded that the island be restored. Amanda continued to work alongside the Hulk after learning that Banner had somehow returned. When she confronted the Hulk in Antarctica, she accused him of lying about Banner's death, but soon realized that the two personalities had been reunited. The Hulk asked for her assistance in pursuing Doctor Doom, whom he believed responsible for the events that had driven Banner insane. Amanda agreed and brought him aboard the Mad Squad's ship, where she had recruited the gamma-mutated monkey encountered during Banner's experiments. She also revealed that her team had captured a Doombot connected to the scientist's island, providing the Hulk with a possible lead. During their subsequent assault on the Doombots' secret base in the African Serengeti, Amanda fought alongside the Hulk and the Mad Squad against Doom's robotic forces and their army of gamma-irradiated animals. Before the operation, she kissed the Hulk and warned him that she would castrate him with a chainsaw if he killed Doctor Doom before she had the opportunity to do so.

Amanda and the Mad Squad subsequently confronted the scientist on his island, where they encountered his monstrous creations and discovered that he had prepared a gamma bomb. When the bomb detonated, Banner was killed, and Amanda later witnessed the Hulk mourning the remains of his former alter ego alongside the surviving creatures. She and her team were then forced to negotiate with the gamma-mutates, who demanded that the island be restored. Amanda continued to work alongside the Hulk after learning that Banner had somehow returned. When she confronted the Hulk in Antarctica, she accused him of lying about Banner's death, but soon realized that the two personalities had been reunited. The Hulk asked for her assistance in pursuing Doctor Doom, whom he believed responsible for the events that had driven Banner insane. Amanda agreed and brought him aboard the Mad Squad's ship, where she had recruited the gamma-mutated monkey encountered during Banner's experiments. She also revealed that her team had captured a Doombot connected to the scientist's island, providing the Hulk with a possible lead. During their subsequent assault on the Doombots' secret base in the African Serengeti, Amanda fought alongside the Hulk and the Mad Squad against Doom's robotic forces and their army of gamma-irradiated animals. Before the operation, she kissed the Hulk and warned him that she would castrate him with a chainsaw if he killed Doctor Doom before she had the opportunity to do so.
fields.notes: Amanda has stated that she has no relation to Victor von Doom, though Bruce Banner claimed to see some resemblance; her pregnant mother's imprisonment could imply that a relation to Doctor Doom was the reason. She has refused to read a Doombot's file on her, which might have confirmed their relationship.

amara king.name: Amara King
amara king.origin: Amara was a CIA undercover agent who was supposed to investigate Garrick King. To this end, she went so far as to seduce him and then marry him. She has since begun a surveillance operation on her husband, overhearing her conversations with the Shroud when the latter tried to get Garrick to work for him. Amara contacted her superiors at the CIA after there were complications leading to Scorpion's near death of Garrick and after Inspector Korngold suspected Garrick's criminal activities. Amara later confessed to Shroud that she was a CIA agent and was guarding Garrick on behalf of the Agency after he had stolen $2 million counterfeit dollars from the CIA. She also tried to seduce Shroud, but he rebuffed her. Amara was taken hostage by Lassiter and the Scorpion to convince Garrick to hand over the $2 million dollars, then the Shroud intervened who with a ruse made Amara persuade Garrick to transfer the money, but when the Shroud arrived to save Garrick, he betrayed him by delivering him to the Cult of Kali and when Garrick tried to escape, Amanda killed him by shooting him with a gun.

amara perera.name: Amara Perera
amara perera.origin: Dr. Amara Perera is a brilliant biophysicist who was born and raised on the island of Sri Lanka. Amara had developed a cure for the mutant gene that theoretically prevented Mutants from receiving their abilities, but hadn't dared to create it due to the political and sociological aftermath that would surely occur if she did. She met Tony Stark at a conference in Dubai. Some time later, they had a date in New York City, where she explained her discovery to Stark, but didn't wanted to use it. The date was interrupted when Stark's A.I. assistant Friday notified him of the sighting of Madame Masque in Latveria. left|thumb Following a life-threatening encounter with Madame Masque, Tony visited Amara in her laboratory and opened up to her, and they shared their first kiss. They started dating shortly after, but their relationship ended after Tony faked his own death to infiltrate a clan of bio-tech ninja in Japan. After that she returned to Sri Lanka and lived with Tharik Baas. During Stark's absence, his newfound ally, the reformed Victor von Doom, began to pay attention to Amara, and even set her up a laboratory in Cambridge University and kept her off the grid. When Tony eventually returned, he apologized to Amara and tried to reconnect with her, but she rejected him, feeling he had been cruel of letting her believe he had truly died. Following Tony's fall into a coma, Victor continued visiting Amara, despite her opposition, turning her into his reluctant confidante. Amara's apartment was even destroyed when S.H.I.E.L.D. agent The Thing interrupted an encounter between she and Victor, which resulted in a fight. Amara's unwilling connection with Doom also caught the attention of S.H.I.E.L.D., who would barge into her place of work for questioning more than once, which resulted in her being fired. Not long afterwards, Amara began feeling symptoms of pregnancy. Her friend, a physician named Keren, ran tests and shared with Amara that she was indeed pregnant. It would later be mentioned by Doom that the child didn't survive to term.

amass.name: Amass
amass.origin: ===Threshold=== === War with the Unbreathing and Death === Amass is a mutant of the Threshold. On the declining of their society, caused by the war with the Unbreathing and the massacre caused by the sentient bacteria Sublime and Arkea. Grove selected Amass along with Crave and Theia as a trio whose powers would allow them to transcend time to either find help or preserve their history if help wasn't possible, the Threshold Three. The Threshold Three locked themselves in one body, thanks to Amass' powers, and were launched through time with Theia's powers as a living time capsule. . Unfortunately, the Shi'ar order known as the Kin Crimson foresaw the Threshold Three's attempt and so they intercepted them and they were vaporized. However, the Kin preserved their combined DNA in a timedrive that was stored on the Shi'ar equipment stolen by Magneto to complete Avalon. === Theft of the Timedrive and Resurrection === After 2 billion years, the Marauders, who had time-travelled to the destruction of Avalon, managed to recover the timedrive and erase the memories of the parties involved in the destruction, the Acolytes and Nemesis. A few days later, on Krakoa, even though their DNA had degraded, Cerebra used her powers to reconfigure the sequence and summoned the Five to resurrect the Threshold Three. After they were resurrected, the Marauders informed them of what had happened to them and they told them of Threshold's history. === Time-Travel to Threshold === With the Marauders, the Threshold Three travelled back to ancient Threshold. Unfortunately, they were unable to save Threshold. After returning to the future, Captain Pryde commissioned the resurrection of the Threshold Three because they had died 2 billions year ago but the records of their DNA and Cerebro backups were still on present-day Krakoa. ===War College=== Amass was recommended by the Quiet Council of Krakoa and the Great Captains to be tutored by Bishop as part of his War College operation. Bishop's method involved intensive and ruthless exercises, raising tensions between him and his pupils. Bishop eventually readapted his method with Tempo's help, earning his cadets' approval. However, they were unexpectedly attacked by the Fenris during their training and Bishop was inadvertently transported by Tempo to Earth-63. The Fenris used Blightswill to weaken the young mutants and their power went out of control. in a fight between Andreas Von Strucker and Cam Long they both got absorbed into Amass, and they started attacking Andrea. Andrea managed to divide the three and Amass and Cam were both caught by Orchis but were freed by their team members, who got their powers back just in time for Bishop and Tempo to come back. They all fought Orchis together and left Fenris in the Pit. Then they all graduated from War College and Amass got a B+, with notes from Bishop about the fact that Amass has good potential but he's not ready to fight in a group yet.

amaterasu.name: Amaterasu
amaterasu.origin: ===Origins=== Amaterasu is a member of an extra-dimensional race of beings known as the Amatsu-Kami ("Heavenly Ones") who were worshipped as gods by the Ancient Ainu and Japanese people in Eastern Asia. She is one of a trinity of gods at a large hierarchy of deities along with Susanoo, the storm-god, and Tsukuyomi, the moon-god. left|thumb|Amaterasu ===Third Host=== In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Amaterasu. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened. ===Modern Times=== In modern times, the mutant adventurer Wolverine referred to Japan as “the Land of Amaterasu.” ===Chaos War=== right|thumb|Amaterasu vs. Mikaboshi Amaterasu represented the Amatsu-Kami in the Council of Godheads after Mikaboshi and his army of enslaved alien deities attacked Earth. Although the Asgardian representative Balder wanted to rush into battle against Mikaboshi in order assist the Earth realm, Amaterasu instead sealed off the Council’s throne room in order to safeguard the various pantheons and their respective divine realms from an attack by Mikaboshi. However, the Olympian god Hercules inadvertently enabled Mikaboshi to enter the throne room when he brought the body of his fallen father Zeus (then under Mikaboshi’s influence) to the Council of Godheads’ hidden extradimensional realm, allowing Mikaboshi’s army to attack all of the god realms in rapid succession. When Mikaboshi attacked the Amatsu-Kami’s home realm of Ama, Amaterasu led her fellow Shinto gods (including Inari, Ame-No-Mi-Kumari, Bishamon, Kaminari, and Hotei) in a valiant counterattack which ultimately failed. A triumphant Mikaboshi killed most of the Amatsu-Kami and brought their bodies under his control. left|thumb|Amaterasu under Mikaboshi's control Now under the control of Mikaboshi, Amaterasu and her fellow Amastu-Kami (including Inari, Susanoo, and Tsukuyomi) lured the "God Squad" (an alliance consisting of Silver Surfer, Venus, Sersi, Daimon Hellstrom, and Bast) to their home of Takamagahara (the Plain of High Heaven) within the realm of Ama and presented them with a plan to defeat Mikaboshi by imprisoning him within Yomi. However, once the God Squad were led to the temple within Takamagahara that contained the sealed gateway to Yomi, Amaterasu and the Amatsu-Kami revealed that they were under Mikaboshi’s control and turned on the God Squad, although they were eventually defeated.

amazo.name: Amazo
amazo.origin: Amazo was an stage illusionist who was active in the 1940s. He worked for producer Jim Markham, who cancelled Amazo's show in 1946. Driven insane by this, Amazo then kidnapped Markham with the intention of torturing and killing him. As coincidence would have it, Amazo was interrupted by a visit from Jeff Mace and Fred Davis Jr.. The pair were attempting to call on the parents of one of Jeff' students whose grades were failing. They were unaware that the student had given them the wrong address in order to avoid trouble. Amazo, not wishing to be disturbed told the two men that he would tell his "son" to study better and slammed the door in their face. Down the street Jeff and Fred ran into the student and learned the truth and doubled back to find out what was going on at the house. They arrived just as Amazo began his torture of Markham, forcing him into a wicker basket and stabbing swords into it. Unaware that the basket had a false bottom and Markham was dropped into the basement, Jeff and Fred attacked as Captain America and Bucky. During the fight Amazo made Bucky disappear under his cape (another trap door trick) and then seemingly disappeared before Captain America's eyes (through yet another trap door). Cap was soon waylaid by one of Amazo's men hiding in a suit of armor and tied up in the basement with Amazo's other prisoners. There Amazo explained his revenge scheme and how his tricks worked. This gave Captain America enough time to free himself and attack. The fight was brief as Amazo made the mistake of grabbing a prop gun that only shot flowers and was quickly knocked out and turned over to the authorities.

amber mutant.name: Amber (Mutant)
amber mutant.origin: Amber was one of 19 young mutants who were accepted to Empire State University when that institution actively opened its doors to mutants. Her power consisted into shape-shifting which manifested usually during her dreams, according to her parents' observations. Amber avoided joining the local Students for Tolerance group ran by Gigi Martin, as well as the fringe Magnetic North, and claimed to have joined the university for the free education, and only joined the chess club. Amber met Chamber, who had recently enrolled at ESU. She noticed his attraction to Gigi Martin, and cautioned him about getting involved with her. Chamber met with Amber and revealed to her that he was one of the X-Men, having gone undercover to learn how six of the mutant classmates had died. Later, he visited her dorm room and briefly saw her in her form as a beautiful blonde woman. Amber claimed that that person was her roommate. She assisted him in investigating the mutant-hate group Purity, using her computer, and managed to track down one of the group's members. Later that evening, Chamber entered Amber's room from her window and again beheld her as her "roommate". Amber quickly covered for herself claiming that she had changed rooms. Chamber revealed to her that the man from Purity said that the killer of the six students was a mutant himself. The next day, Amber accompanied Chamber to the scene of the murders. Guessing that a member of Magnetic North might be behind the murders, Chamber was just setting off to see them when Amber kissed him. Chamber reacted badly to this, as he only thought of Amber as a friend. Hurt, Amber told him to leave. After learning from Magnetic North that the mutant who killed the others was, in fact, Gigi Martin's boyfriend and co-founder of the Student for Tolerance: Alex, he broke into Gigi's office to find her holding a gun on Amber, trying to coerce Amber into staying out of the investigation. Having realized what Amber's power was, Chamber communicated with her telepathically, and had her assume the form of Gigi's dead lover Alex. This distracted Gigi long enough for Chamber to disarm her, ending the crisis. With the case solved, Amber explained to Chamber that her "roommate's" form was one she must have dreamed about. Impressed with her looks, Chamber tried to kiss her, but she responded by slapping him. Indignant that even someone as unusual as him could be so ruled by appearances, she thanked him for saving her life, but asked to never see him again. Chamber later learned that all of the mutant students had been expelled from ESU except for Amber. He felt she would be an excellent ambassador to humanity. She was depowered due to M-Day and was most likely killed on the bus when it exploded.
powers: She possesses the ability to shapeshift. This ability commonly manifests itself in her sleep, when she assumes the form of a normal, beautiful young woman, her fantasy ideal.

amber griffen.name: Amber Griffen
amber griffen.origin: Amber Griffen was the daughter of Ryan Griffen, a member of the US Secret Service. As a child, Amber struggled in school and eventually transferred to a new one. On her first day, her father was killed by X-23 on her first mission. Years later, Amber joined the Orphans of X, an organization consisting of surviving family members to those killed by products of the Weapon X program. She became romantically involved with Henry Sutter, another member orphaned by X-23. The Orphans of X were enraged when Laura Kinney (now going by "Wolverine") was publicly honored as a hero for her role in saving the residents of Roosevelt Island, and made it their mission to hunt down and kill the remaining Wolverines. Amber and Henry promised each other that when they killed X-23, they would pull the trigger together. The Orphans of X successfully hunted down and killed Old Man Logan, Daken, Sabretooth, and Lady Deathstrike using Muramasa Bullets, which their healing factors were powerless against. Laura and her clone "sister", Gabby, tracked down the four killed and were able to revive them by cutting away the damaged tissue and letting them heal normally. Soon after, Laura confronted the Orphans of X, wearing the Muramasa Armor, which made her impervious to their bullets. However, Laura removed her armor and was made vulnerable before them. She forced Henry to admit his father's role in her upbringing (something he'd neglected to tell Amber) and calmly stated that she no longer held herself responsible for the murders she'd been forced to commit as an exploited child. Laura managed to convince Amber and the other Orphans that they were all victims of the same system and promised to help them track down and bring to justice every person who'd paid for her services as an assassin, proclaiming herself to be an Orphan of X. Some time later, Laura visited Amber to tell her she'd tracked down Chad Newman, the man who'd ordered the hit on Senator Greg Johnson, which led to Amber's father being killed. Amber and Laura traveled to Vanuatu, where Newman had fled after the assassination. Newman immediately was made aware of Amber's arrival and ordered his guards to take her into custody, which they did. After Laura tracked them down, Newman recognized her and threatened to fire on civilians unless she stood down. It was then that Amber revealed that X-23 had not come back for revenge, but she had. Amber electrocuted him while Laura immobilized the guards and they both stuffed Newman in a suitcase. They hauled the suitcase onto a speed boat and drove into international water, preparing to be picked up. Before turning in Newman, Amber took out a pair to boots to use to stomp on him with. She also invited Laura to join, reasoning that he had played a role in destroying both of their childhoods, and they opened the suitcase and stomped on him together.

amber silverstein.name: Amber Silverstein
amber silverstein.origin: thumb|left|200px|Amber SilversteinAmber Silverstein first met Nadia Van Dyne in Times Square while the latter was attempting to recruit Priya Aggarwal to join G.I.R.L.. The pair bonded over a love for science, but soon parted at Nadia went off to meet Shay Smith. Nadia attempted to find Amber again, to recruit her to join Pym Labs as well, but to no avail. She later learned Amber had taken the alias Seeker and was working for A.I.M. to steal an artifact from Horizon Labs, which they believed to be vital in stopping Hank Pym from spreading the Ultron Virus. Amber took part in the assault on Pym Labs by A.I.M., where she personally attempted to kidnap Shay and steal her prototype teleporter. Amber was confronted by Ying, who threatened her, but ultimately it was Shay who engaged Amber's jetpack and caused her to abandon her goal. Amber then led the other A.I.M. lieutenants to a waiting blimp where they made their getaway. Amber and A.I.M. later attacked the G.I.R.L. Expo at the Javits Convention Center. Amber assisted in the attack, capturing Priya, but later fought and was beaten by Nadia. When Monica made a getaway by blowing up Shay's portal, Nadia saved Amber from being sucked into the vacuum. It was then revealed the Amber had been convinced to join the team by Monica, who told Amber that Nadia was working with Ultron. In the aftermath of the G.I.R.L. Expo, Amber was offered a position as part of G.I.R.L., which she accepted.

amber sunrise.name: Amber Sunrise
amber sunrise.origin: Amber Sunrise was a woman who went on a date with a drunken Tony Stark. He sneaked her into Avengers Mansion, while most of the other Avengers left for the night. Tony led her to a computer room and demonstrated his latest gadgets to her. She found them to be cute. They were located by Edwin Jarvis, who was searching for intruders. He was concerned that Stark was demonstrating classified equipment to her. He also reminded Stark that Henry Gyrich would be upset about this breach of security. Tony got angry with Jarvis and belittled him. Amber convinced Tony to show her more gadgets. The next morning, Tony woke up alone.

ambient energy dampening actualization m.page_title: Ambient-Energy Dampening Actualization Module Unit Eleven (Earth-4935)
ambient energy dampening actualization m.origin: Eleven was created in the late 37th century by the Askani as a prototype for the Ambient-Energy Dampening Automated peacekeeping Mechanisms (ADAMs). Only one other ADAM unit was known: Zero, who was found by Stryfe and worked for the New Canaanites. At some point, Eleven was found by members of the Clan Chosen and battled with them against the New Canaanites and Scions of the High Lord, groups that wished to claim Apocalypse's power after his defeat by the Askani'son. Cable brought his Six Pack teammate Kane to the future and left him with the Clan Chosen, while waiting for Cable to return. Cable returned to Kane in Applecrust and aided the Clan Chosen in battling a group of Flatliners. The Clan Chosen decided to send Kane home and destroy the Tinex, the time-travel nexus, within Niagara Falls.

ambrose connors.name: Ambrose Connors
ambrose connors.origin: Head of nuclear research at C.T.E., Ambrose Connors ordered the mercenary Warhawk to kill Ronald English, intending to sell the Nucleonic Radiator that had turned English into an Atom-Smasher to various dictatorships around the world. When Hawkeye worked as chief of security at C.T.E., Connors ordered him to recover the radioactive isotope that Mister Fear had stolen from C.T.E. if he didn't want to be fired. El Aguila found out what the plans of the C.T.E. with the Nucleonic Radiator and then tried to destroy it by breaking into the C.T.E., where Hawkeye was head of security and Aguila pretended to have been defeated by him. Connors, despite Hawkeye's warning not to trust El Aguila's helplessness, began to scoff at him until, using his powers, he short-circuited Hawkeye's arrows freeing himself and, thanks to Hawkeye's wrong shot, destroyed the Radiator and then fled. Connors accused Hawkeye of deliberately missing the shot and then threatened to fire him, but Hawkeye pointed out to Connors that he was the one who had taken El Aguila to the Radiator by telling him that he would show the images the cameras had recorded to the head of the C.T.E.

ambrose mcallister.origin: Ambrose McAllister was a college student and athlete. Being late for his date with his girlfriend Helen, he decided to turn back the hands of the clock on the tower using it as an excuse to tell her that the clock had deceived him. Climbing the stairs of the tower, however, Ambrose mysteriously found himself in the arena of the Olympic games of Ancient Greece and there he had to face some sports tests that thanks to his athletic skills he managed to win in a masterly way. During the award ceremony by the lord of the games, he introduced his daughter to Ambrose saying that she wanted to meet the great athlete and said her name was Helen. Hearing Helen's name brought everything back to his mind, so he ran back to the Clock Tower and put the hands back in place he returned to his era, and when he introduced himself to his Helen and told him what had happened she replied that she would never believe him but then she saw the laurel wreath of the winners on his head.

ambrose meek.name: Ambrose Meek
ambrose meek.origin: thumb|left|121px|Ambrose Q. Meek Ambrose Q. Meek lived up to his name and lived a meek existence as a shopkeeper. Growing to despise his clientele -- seeing them as always being wrong -- and wishing for money and power, he would develop the masked identity of Doctor Fear. As Fear, frightened people to death with his ghastly mask. He would first murder a man walking home after a late night at a local club. Returning to the scene in his civilian guise he would rouse the police and act faint around the dead body to appear as though he were nothing more than same old Ambrose Meek. When this only netted him a story on in the back of the newspaper, the furious Doctor Fear vowed to up the ante of his next crime. His next attack would come at a bank just before lunch, where his horrifying looks would kill all the customers, tellers and security guards. Doctor Fear would rob all the corpses before fleeing the scene. Later after the authorities arrived on the scene with criminologist Mark Todd (secretly the hero known as Blazing Skull), Meek would once more appear at the scene of the crime. This time, he would boldly demand that more be done to stop this killer -- shocking authorities at his sudden direct and aggressive behavior. This outburst would work to Meek's advantage as the town gossip mill would be in full swing, with the story of Doctor Fear's murder spree at the bank made more and more grand and tall a tale by each retelling. thumb|left That night, Meek was out on the deserted streets when he was confronted by Todd, who wished to know what he was up to. Ambrose would angrily snap at the criminologist for infringing on his rights and promptly leave the area. Returning shortly thereafter as Doctor Fear, Ambrose would attempt to slay Todd by tossing him off a bridge. Deciding to demand a ransom, Doctor Fear would head to the local radio station to make his demands to the city, unaware that Todd had survived and was now chasing him as Blazing Skull. At the radio station, Doctor Fear would interrupt a live broadcast to demand a ransom of one million dollars from the city. These demands were be interrupted by the Blazing Skull, who fought Doctor Fear into submission on the roof of the radio building. Unmasked in the struggle, Ambrose surrendered explaining his motivations to turn to crime. thumb|left By the Modern Age, an elderly Ambrose Meek became a resident of Valhalla Villas, a retirement home for ex-heroes and ex-villains that is located in Miami. He is among the residents that were de-aged by Mary Morgan (who used an unnamed Asgardian relic) so they could enjoy one last chance at youth before the end of the world as there was an active Incursion between Earth-616 and Earth-1610.

ambrose winthrop.name: Ambrose Winthrop
ambrose winthrop.origin: A few centuries into the past, Ambrose Winthrop was a settler travelling through the territory of Kansas on a caravan with his wife and their two children, a toddler and a baby. Due to the machinations of the demon Mephisto, Winthrop found himself stuck in a blizzard, with his caravan broken and their mule dead, unable to eat it since the animal had suddenly become infested with maggots. Winthrop prayed for help, stating he would do anything to have his family survive and thrive. In the form of a serpent, Mephisto answered his plea. The demon agreed to ensure Winthrop's family thrived, but not his current family. As a collateral for the pact, Mephisto had Ambrose kill and cannibalize his wife and children. Surviving the blizzard, Winthrop traveled west, where he married new wives and had many children, becoming a successful and wealthy man. After Ambrose's death, Mephisto came to his widow since the debt for his success befell on his family. As a reminder of Winthrop's debt, he collected a finger from his widow and each of their children. Mephisto would return many times over the decades, collecting different tokens, like the firstborn children of each Wintrhop generation or requesting favors. As a result, the Winthrops continued thriving. Ambrose's debt was finally paid in the modern age, when Mephisto came to Ambrose Randolph Wintrop's great-great-grandson Oliver and devoured him and his family.

After Ambrose's death, Mephisto came to his widow since the debt for his success befell on his family. As a reminder of Winthrop's debt, he collected a finger from his widow and each of their children. Mephisto would return many times over the decades, collecting different tokens, like the firstborn children of each Wintrhop generation or requesting favors. As a result, the Winthrops continued thriving. Ambrose's debt was finally paid in the modern age, when Mephisto came to Ambrose Randolph Wintrop's great-great-grandson Oliver and devoured him and his family.

ambrose 7.name: Ambrose-7
ambrose 7.species: Automaton with transferred human brain patterns
ambrose 7.origin: Ambrose-7 was an automaton created by the Triad on a world where humanity had been enslaved and replaced by mechanical replicas. Unlike the world's ordinary mechanical inhabitants, Ambrose-7 contained human brain patterns, the result of an early Triad experiment involving the transfer of a human mind into a robotic body. ===Meeting Cody Pace=== Ambrose-7 encountered Cody Pace's companions Ivory Darc, Ort, Jabot Wafloon, and Gaelen Piecekeeper while they were attempting to oppose the Triad. Ambrose-7 warned the travelers that venturing openly into the outside world would cause them to be detected by Triad patrols. He explained that he had been created when the Triad transferred a human brain without its owner's consent into a mechanical body. Resenting the Triad for what had been done to him, Ambrose-7 expressed his desire to see them destroyed and offered to help the travelers. Cody, frustrated by the secrets surrounding his mission, initially refused to participate and left to seek his own way home. His companions followed Ambrose-7 through the sewer system but were eventually captured by Triad security forces and Kilobots. After learning that his companions were about to be executed, Cody returned and rescued them. Gaelen subsequently used his remaining soul-arrows against the Triad, destroying it and apparently sacrificing his own life in the resulting explosion. ===Betrayal=== Following the destruction of the Triad, Ambrose-7 revealed that he had betrayed Cody and his companions. Malevelos had promised Ambrose-7 that he would make him fully human. In exchange, Ambrose-7 intended to deliver Cody, his surviving companions, and the mystical battlepike Devilthorn to Malevelos. Ambrose-7 used his technology to place Cody and his companions in stasis and prepared to transport them to Malevelos. ===Death=== Ambrose-7's betrayal was interrupted when the small reptilian creatures that carried Jabot Wafloon's barge attacked him. During the confrontation, Ambrose-7 seized Devilthorn. However, the mystical power contained within the battlepike overwhelmed him and caused his mechanical body to explode, killing him. With Ambrose-7 destroyed, Cody and his companions were freed and continued their search for a means of reaching Malevelos on Golgotha.
powers: As an automaton, Ambrose-7 possessed abilities derived from his mechanical body. The full extent of these capabilities is unknown.
weaknesses: Mystical Energy: Ambrose-7's mechanical body was unable to withstand the mystical power contained within Devilthorn. Attempting to wield the battlepike caused him to explode.

However, by this time Mikaboshi was simply too powerful, and he handily defeated and enslaved Ame-No-Mi-Kumari and the other assembled Amatsu-Kami.

amelia barnhardt.name: Amelia Barnhardt
amelia barnhardt.origin: Amelia Barnhardt, also known as Sprocket, was once a mercenary. During that time in her life she became friends with fellow mercenary Andrew Chord. It was through this friendship that Sprocket was able to get the position as the pilot for Night Thrasher and the New Warriors. During a mission in Rhodesia, Amelia had a one night stand with fellow mercenary Cardinal. The next day, Cardinal disappeared, leaving Sprocket with the bar tab. Sprocket soon found out she was pregnant and eventually gave birth to a daughter named Valerie. Sprocket chose not to tell Cardinal about their daughter. When Valerie was six she was enrolled in a military academy. At 18 she joined the air force to be a pilot like her mother. Lt. Valerie Barnhardt's military career was cut short when she crippled the commanding officer who raped her. Valerie was offered a chance to clear her record for enrolling in the CSA's Redeemers program. Valerie took the codename Meteorite. Valerie and many of her fellow Redeemers were murdered by the supervillain Graviton. Valerie died at the age of 21. After the body was recovered by SHIELD a DNA test confirmed that Cardinal was indeed Meteorite's father. Sprocket visited Cardinal in prison and told him the truth about their daughter. According to Sprocket she hadn't spoken with her daughter in the three years since she joined the military.

amelia weatherly.name: Amelia Weatherly
amelia weatherly.origin: In recruiting members for a strike force to save his Alpha Flight (who were captured by the alien race, the Plodex), Walter Langkowski recruited the third woman to wear the Nemesis guise, Amelia Weatherley. Cashing in the last of his official government favors, Langkowski had Nemesis brought to an old Department H lab. There he injected her with nano-technology and attached a device to her spine. He used these means to control the otherwise erratic and potentially dangerous Nemesis. Should she attempt to harm an innocent, or dislodge the device, she would be flooded with neo-floxins that would be capable of permanently severing her connection to the Soul Sword. Since it was the sword that gave the otherwise dead Nemesis life, this could prove to be fatal. Joining Walter Langkowski's new Alpha Flight, Nemesis took part in the rescue of the old members from the Plodex. After they decided to transport the remaining Plodex eggs to their homeworld, the new team decided to stay together to protect Canada. When Alpha Flight's old foe Flashback came to them for help, he explained how he was running out of time. Years ago in a battle with Madison Jeffries, one of Flashback's future selves was killed. He swore off super-villainy, burned his costume, and hoped to avoid his fate. When his "inverted" costume appeared in his bathroom, and suddenly found himself dressed in it, he knew his time was running short. Contacting Alpha Flight, he asked them to travel back in time and alter the past to prevent his death. Rather than simply doing this, Langkowski decided they might as well fix a few things while they were at it, and prevent Guardian's near death experience. Nemesis was the hinge in this plan, as she had time traveling capabilities locked in her sword. Needing a blood connection from the time they planned to visit, Nemesis ran her sword through Flashback, killing him. She reasoned that any death that should happen would be undone when the past was "fixed". One by one Nemesis "killed" the members of Alpha Flight to send them to the past, each time messing up the timeline even more. As the last straw, she ran herself through to see if she could herself fix time. In the end, Alpha Flight managed to get things back on track (more or less), saved Flashback and restored the timeline. Since then all that has been seen of Nemesis was a glimpse into the possible future where she was dead side-by-side with her lost love, Rutherford Princeton. Nemesis seems to have been an adult in Chicago during the Prohibition. It is not known how long she had been alive prior to this era. During this time, she had a romantic involvement with Rutherford Princeton, later to become Centennial, her Alpha Flight teammate.

amenhotep iii.name: Amenhotep III
amenhotep iii.origin: Amenhotep III, also known as Amenophis III and Amenhotep the Great, was one of the most powerful rulers of Egypt’s Eighteenth Dynasty. His reign was remembered as an era of prosperity, monumental construction, and political influence. His grand mortuary complex was largely lost to time, with its most famous surviving remnants being the colossal statues who depicted him known as the Colossi of Memnon, which once stood at the entrance of his funerary temple.

ameretat.name: Ameretat
ameretat.origin: ===Origins=== Allegedly, according to the ancient Zoroastrian lore, Ahura Mazda, the creator god, emerged from the personification of infinite time, Zurvan. A wise and benevolent representing truth, order and justice, Ahura Mazda started populating his domain with life. His birth was soon followed in the one of his twisted mirror image and antithesis, Ahriman, who personified deceit and chaos. Ahriman rejected the peace offerings of Ahura Mazda and tried to kill the life who had been imbued in his domain. After a prolonged battle, narrowly overcame and banished him to the Nether Realms. Ameretat, goddess of creation was one of the Yazatas created by Ahura Mazda to uphold order and justice and in preparation for Ahriman's return. Banished, Ahmriman created the Divs, demonic gods with the sole purpose of opposing the Yazatas. Since then, the two groups have waged an endless war against each often, often using mortals as pawn in attempt to gain the upper hand. The Yazatas ended up being worshiped on Earth in the Persian/Iranian plateau, as well as in Central Asia and India, from 1000 BC into modern days. The nexus between Earth and Elysium was indeed located on Mount Damavand in the Alborz Mountains and at Naqsh-e Rustam (within modern-day Iran). ===Third Host=== In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Ameretat. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened.
powers: Yazata Physiology: Presumably all of the Yazatas' powers. Chlorokinesis: Ameretat can generate and control all plant life.

The Super-Soldier told his teammates that his latest govrernment assignment was to follow the trail of stolen government equipment which was being smuggled overseas. American Belle requested further details, but the Super-Soldier told her that he had not been told why this mission was so important. He also reminded to the Belle that he could not share official secrets with her, even when they were available to him. She apologozed for prying, and blushed. She claimed thay she was merely concerned about his safety. Her dialogue implied that she was omantically intereste in the Super-Soldier, but too shy to expess her feelings for him.
powers: She also has the power to create sonic vibrational pulses.

american panther.name: American Panther
american panther.first_appearance: Black Panther: The Man Without Fear Vol 1 521
american panther.origin: The American Panther's early life was scarred by the death of his father at the hands of his mother's lover. Extradited to a Swedish court in order to face trial, his father's murderer walked free on a technicality, leading the Panther to blame the corruption of foreigners for the miscarriage of justice. In response, the young man sought training and vengeance, eventually tracking down his father's murderer in Sweden before executing him. Following this the Panther also served as a police officer in New York; this occupation allowed him to give full vent to all his repressed rage by demonstrating an extreme antipathy towards foreigners and immigrants, a character trait that attracted the attention of the Hate-Monger. Sculpting the man into the champion of his twisted ideology, Hate Monger set about wresting Hell's Kitchen from the watch of the Black Panther. Even after he was released from the Hate-Monger's control, the American Panther still fought against the Black Panther. His career was short-lived, however, as he was taken into police custody soon after.
abilities: American Panther has hand-to-hand combat training.

amina synge.name: Amina Synge
amina synge.species: Human with potential activated by First Fallen
amina synge.origin: Amina Synge grew up with the rest of the Foursaken. She was the girlfriend of Jamie Braddock. She gained her powers while entering a rally with Jamie in the desert. There she and the rest of the Forsaken met the First Fallen who activated their powers and chose them to represent earth in his paradise world. The other three members of the group were Jamie Braddock, Godfrey Calthrop and Ned Horrocks. They involved themselves with the X-Men and a paradisical realm called the 'Singing City'. It was said that humanity would live on in this new place, but it was soon discovered only four humans would make the cut. All others would not. The X-Men were not persuaded by the argument that humanity would live on in the four who survived and battle to stop the plans. Amina, along with the other Forsaken, rebelled against the Fallen. Ned would die and Jamie sacrifices himself to save the others. Amina blamed Psylocke for leaving Jamie behind but Godfrey calmed her and left with her.
powers: Amina can summon ectoplasmic salamander-creatures that tear the souls out of people.
affiliations: formery ally of the First Fallen

aminedi.name: Aminedi
aminedi.origin: Aminedi was a member of the Iraqi mercenary team Desert Sword. When they fought against Crimson Commando's Freedom Force, Aminedi decapitated Super Sabre and cut off Crimson Commando's right arm. Aminedi and Sirocco trapped Avalanche and Crimson Commando in a minefield. Avalanche trapped Aminedi and Sirocco under a pile of rock and managed to escape with Crimson Commando, however, Blob and Pyro were captured by the Desert Sword. At an unknown point Aminedi contracted the Legacy Virus. He eventually died from the disease. His death was reported during a brainstorming session about the virus by Charles Xavier, Moira MacTaggert, and Hank McCoy.

amino fetus.name: Amino Fetus
amino fetus.origin: Amino Fetus is a mutant from Arakko, genetically modified by the demon mutant Tarn the Uncaring. Amino Fetus is a cause of constant concern for his fellows in the Locus Vile, as they are forced to constantly keep an eye on him to prevent him from eating, since his doing so would bring about the end of the universe. He is part of the Locus Vile, who confronted the Hellions when they went to Arakko to try to steal the swords of the Swordbearers of Arakko to prevent the tournament in Otherworld. Amino Fetus and the other Locus Vile were led into Krakoa by Tarn to punish Sinister and the Hellions for stealing their genetic material. During the battle, Amino Fetus was fed by Greycrow, forcing Tarn to throw him into a black hole at the edge of the universe in order to save all of creation.
powers: breaking down into a horde of gremlin-like creatures that can spread, feed, and multiply at incredible rates, consuming the very temporal quintessence of reality and causing it to unravel and deteriorate.
aliases: The Lumbering Shame Accursed Embryo Accursed Infants
